DERICHEBOURG Umwelt GmbH
ist eine deutsche Tochter der französischen DERICHEBOURG Gruppe und zählt zu den weltweit führenden Recycling Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung des hochwertigen Wertstoffs Metall. Durch Rückführung des Sekundärrohstoffs in den Verarbeitungskreislauf schützen wir vorhandene Ressourcen und leisten somit einen hohen Beitrag zum Umweltschutz. Weltweit sind wir mit mehr als 10.800 Mitarbeiter in 160 Niederlassungen tätig. In Deutschland beschäftigen wir an 6 Standorten derzeit ca. 130 Mitarbeiter. Trotz unserer Größe bleiben wir ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien und legen großen Wert auf eine faire Zusammenarbeit und ein angenehmes Betriebsklima.
Sie haben Spaß an einem dynamischen Umfeld, können anpacken, begeistern sich für Wert- und Rohstoffe der Kreislaufwirtschaft und können gut mit Menschen umgehen?
Dann sind Sie bei der DERICHEBOURG Umwelt GmbH genau richtig!

Bei Syensqo geht es um Chemie. Hierbei sprechen wir nicht nur von chemischen Reaktionen, sondern auch von der Magie, die entsteht, wenn die klügsten Köpfe zusammenarbeiten. Hier liegt unsere wahre Stärke. In Ihnen. In Ihren zukünftigen Kollegen und in all Ihren Unterschieden. Und natürlich in Ihren Ideen, um das Leben zu verbessern, während wir die Schönheit unseres Planeten für die kommenden Generationen bewahren.
Syensqo produziert in Östringen bei Heidelberg Hochleistungsverbundwerkstoffe sowie dünnflüssige Kunstharze und ist in diesem Segment weltweit führend. Unsere Hightech-Produkte genügen höchsten Anforderungen, haben eine hohe Innovationskraft und werden unter extremen Bedingungen eingesetzt.
Wir suchen:
Unsere Kunden finden sich in der Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie im Bereich Automotive. Hier haben wir unsere Kapazitäten erweitert und suchen für unseren Schichtbetrieb Mitarbeiter für die Produktion (m/w/d).
Wir benötigen Sie für:
Bedienen von Anlagen und Maschinen (Mischer, Beschichtungs- und Imprägnieranlagen)
Weiterverarbeitung, Inspektion und Verpackung der produzierten Verbundwerkstoffe
Einhaltung der Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards
Beseitigung von Störungen an Anlagen
Mitarbeit bei Verbesserungsprojekten
Umsetzung von TPM Maßnahmen
Wir bieten:
Ein herausforderndes, bereicherndes und internationales Arbeitsumfeld in einem global agierenden Unternehmen
Sie bringen mit:
abgeschlossene Ausbildung im technischen oder handwerklichen Bereich, wie z.B. Chemikant, Chemiefacharbeiter, Mechatroniker oder Maschinen- und Anlagenführer.
Idealerweise Erfahrung in einem industriellen Umfeld
Bereitschaft in Wechselschicht zu arbeiten
Teamarbeit
Eigeninitiative
Sie bekommen:
Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt innerhalb des Tarifvertrages der chemischen Industrie
Gruppenunfallversicherung zusätzlich zur gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung
Arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
16 Wochen bezahlte Mutterschafts-/Vaterschaftsurlaub und Elternzeit
Schulungsplattform für alle Mitarbeiter
Well-being Programme zur Förderung der Work-Life-Balance
Über uns
Syensqo ist ein Wissenschaftsunternehmen, das wegweisende Lösungen entwickelt, um unsere Lebens-, Arbeits-, Reise- und Freizeitgestaltung zu verbessern. Inspiriert von den wissenschaftlichen Räten, die Ernest Solvay 1911 ins Leben gerufen hat, bringen wir herausragende Köpfe zusammen, um die Grenzen von Wissenschaft und Innovation zum Nutzen unserer Kunden zu erweitern. Mit einem vielfältigen globalen Team von mehr als 13.000 Mitarbeitern setzen wir uns für diese Vision ein. Unsere Lösungen tragen dazu bei, sicherere, sauberere und nachhaltigere Produkte in Haushalten, Lebensmitteln und Konsumgütern, Flugzeugen, Autos, Batterien, intelligenten Geräten und Anwendungen im Gesundheitswesen zu schaffen. Unsere Innovationskraft ermöglicht es uns, die Ambitionen einer Kreislaufwirtschaft zu verwirklichen und bahnbrechende Technologien zu erforschen, die die Menschheit voranbringen.
Bei Syensqo streben wir nach Einheit und nicht nach Gleichförmigkeit. Wir schätzen die Vielfalt, die Einzelpersonen einbringen, und laden Sie ein, unabhängig von Hintergrund, Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, Ethnizität, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Fähigkeiten oder Identität eine Zukunft mit uns in Betracht zu ziehen. Wir ermutigen Personen, die Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigen, uns dies mitzuteilen, um eine reibungslose Bewerbungserfahrung zu gewährleisten. Wir stehen Ihnen während des Bewerbungsprozesses zur Seite und möchten sicherstellen, dass alle Bewerber gleich behandelt werden. Wenn Sie sich nicht sicher sind, ob Sie alle in der Stellenbeschreibung aufgeführten Kriterien oder Qualifikationen erfüllen, ermutigen wir Sie dennoch zur Bewerbung.
Wie Sie vielleicht bereits wissen, ist Syensqo das neu gegründete eigenständige Unternehmen, das aus der kürzlichen Abspaltung von Solvay hervorgegangen ist. Während beide Organisationen den Übergang abschließen, könnten einige E-Mail-Kommunikationen im Zusammenhang mit Ihrem Auswahlprozess weiterhin von Solvay stammen.

job_title_name: Consultant / Manager (m/f/d) in the field of Sustainable Finance, Madrid based (part-time/full-time)
job_description:
Consultant / Manager (m/f/d)
In the field of Sustainable Finance, Madrid based (part-time/full-time) // adelphi Consult
adelphi is Europe's leading independent think-and-do tank on climate, environment and development. As a leading policy consultancy, we advocate for just transformative change and a livable and sustainable society. 300 bright minds work locally and globally on environment and sustainability and the challenges of political, economic and social change.
Exciting tasks in a varied environment await you with us. Contribute your ideas and expertise to our interdisciplinary, international teams and benefit from networked working and learning as well as flat hierarchies.
PART TIME / FULL TIME
Madrid
Job summary
As a Consultant/Manager in adelphi’s Finance programme, your role is to support our project for international financial institutions (IFIs) and commercial banks in the successful implementation of sustainable finance strategies and programmes. Projects may include the development of climate action strategies, the implementation of credit lines for energy efficiency or renewable energy financing, the management of financing facilities that support clean-tech or biodiversity investments, and consulting on financial tools and products focusing on resource efficiency or circular economy.
Diversity is important to us. For a sustainable future, we need a diversity of experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.
Your tasks
Depending on your background and expertise, responsibilities may include the following:
conceptual design, development, and implementation of targeted and impactful expert support services, materials, trainings, and tools for financial institutions
management of international projects including contract, budget, and deliverable management
delivery of high-quality expert advice regarding sustainable finance processes and tools, financial product development and market assessments, sustainable project and loan pipeline development, or the development of capacities for sustainable financing
coordination of internal and external teams of consultants and colleagues
Regular exchange with clients such as IFIs and commercial banks
quality assurance and compliance with project terms
Further, as a colleague in our Finance programme, you contribute to the strategic orientation and further development of our sustainable finance services; you manage and write successful proposals and participate in other business development activities; you guide and advise junior team members; and you exchange with your colleagues on a regular basis to continuously advance our team’s expertise, quality of services, and team spirit.
Your qualifications
Essential:
Minimum 3 to 5 years of work experience in the field of sustainable finance with a strong focus on project management and consulting
A university degree (or similar qualification)
Initial work experience in one or several thematic areas of sustainable finance, such as EU Taxonomy, TCFD, NFRD/CSRD, SFDR, climate risk assessment (for financial institutions)
Commitment to and sincere interest in sustainable finance, high motivation to advance national and international sustainable finance agenda’s in direct collaboration with international and national financial institutions, including commercial banks
good overview of recent sustainable finance trends and initiatives
Experience in the acquisition, development and implementation of consulting projects and in the design of training measures
A solution-, client-, and quality-oriented approach to work
Ability to oversee various activities at once ensuring timely and successful implementation
Creative team-player with strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as attention to detail;
Interest in a long-term collaboration in a dynamically working and growing team;
Excellent oral and written expression in Spanish and English
Willingness to occasionally travel to project countries for short-term stays
Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office suite of programmes
Desired:
Excellent oral and written expression additional languages such as Portuguese and/or French are an advantage
Experience in working for the financial sector either as consultant or directly is a strong plus
Experience in the design and implementation of technical assistance/expert support for sustainability/green credit lines
Knowledge and experience in developing and running trainings to the financial sector
We offer...
A job with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to strengthen your profile and experience in sustainable finance and pro-actively shape your area of work
Possibility to strive creatively and shape impactful solutions for sustainable finance, quickly take on responsibility for projects and versatile tasks
Be part of a growing and dynamic sustainable finance team in an impact-oriented consulting company
Flat hierarchies and a flexible work environment as well as friendly and committed colleagues
Continuous advancement of your competencies, active work-life balance through flexible working hours and working time models, possibility to re-enter the space after leave or after work in other sectors
Attractive benefits (e.g. discounted Urban Sports Club membership)
Option to work partly remotely and partly at easily accessible co-working space in Madrid
The position is initially limited to 2 years. If the cooperation is successful, we will have a strong interest to transform it into a permanent position.
Your application
We therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality or ethnic and social origin. Recognised severely disabled persons or persons of equal status will be given preferential consideration in the case of equal suitability.
Please send a full application including cover letter, CV, references and further documents you deem relevant.
Please use only the way via our online application

Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills,

score4more - The B2B Sustainability Impact Startup

COMPANIES: We engineer the sustainability data of companies in a company profile and provide data analytics comparison on an industry-specific basis.

PEOPLE: We connect and support the change agents - those committed to collaborate in order to create sustainable transformation across companies

job_description:

Leipzig

Contract limitations

Salary
Remuneration according to the TVöD public-sector up to pay grade EG 13 including attractive public-sector social security benefits.
Contact

Dr. Anja Worrich
anja.worrich@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
The UFZ offers four PhD positions in the framework of the PhD college “Coupling circular economy principles with environmental hazard management for liquid manure-based sustainable agriculture- SmartManure”. The aim of SmartManure is to address on-farm manure management from storage to land application, combining aspects of circular economy with sustainable agriculture, and develop technical solutions based on the joint research within the PhD college (see https://www.ufz.de/Smartmanure for more information).
Your tasks
Intensive crop production in agriculture contributes to a decline in soil microbial diversity, which is crucial for soil health and food safety as it acts as insurance against stressors. In this subproject of SmartManure you will identify suitable cover crops that stimulate the soil microbiome to become more resilient to manure-related hazards, while improving nutrient retention from applied manure.
Your tasks will be to:
Design and conduct pot experiments and field trials with different cover crops.
Analyze shifts in microbial diversity and composition in the soils.
Track antibiotics, antibiotic resistance genes and heavy metals in the soils.
Determine nutrient retention from manure and changes in nitrate leaching and greenhouse gas emission.
Analyze and statistically evaluate data.
Participate in the UFZ graduate school HIGRADE with options for targeted training.
Publish the results (peer-reviewed papers, national and international conferences).
Collaborate with all other PhD candidates of SmartManure.
Interact with stakeholders such as farmers and agencies.
We offer
Excellent technical facilities which are without parallel
The freedom you need to bridge the difficult gap between basic research and close to being ready for application
Work in inter-disciplinary, multinational teams
Excellent links with national and international research networks
Excellent support and optimal subject-specific and general training with our HIGRADE graduate school
Your profile
Master's degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biology, Environmental Science or a related field
Readiness for intensive field work
Skills in data evaluation (e.g. R)
High motivation and teamplayer skills are expected
Excellent communication skills (English required)
Ability to work independently and motivated to work in an interdisciplinary team
Additional skills are of added value
Preference will be given to people highly interested in soil microbiology and molecular biology
Driving licence in Germany
Experience in microbial community analysis
Knowledge of plant-based research and conducting greenhouse and field trials

diversity
and actively supports
equal opportunities
for all employees regardless of their origin, religion, ideology, disability, age or sexual identity.
We look forward to applications from people who are open-minded and enjoy working in diverse teams.
Important
Please submit your application via our online portal with your cover letter, CV (please omit your
photo

Performance Optimization: Optimize AI/ML models for speed, efficiency, and scalability to handle large datasets and high workloads.

Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain quality assurance processes to identify and address issues in AI/ML-systems.
Adaptability: Be open to learning and working on a wide range of AI/ML-related tasks and projects, depending on the company's evolving needs.
YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML or a related field.
More than 7+ years of development and proven experience in AI and machine learning model development
Initial project leadership experiences, mentoring younger developers, managing projects, ambitions to coordinate tech roles
Strong AI/ML model training and related programming skills in languages such as Python (see Tech Stack)
Proficiency in data management and analysis using data analytics, data mining and data warehouse tools
Knowledge in deep learning, neural networks, and relevant libraries.
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms, such as AWS
Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation
You have start-up experience, preferably early stage, and have already built structures and developed strategies from scratch.
You work on eye level with your colleagues and consider what is best for the team. Diversity & inclusion are important to you.
The following language skills are a prerequisite: excellent English
What you bring - "nice to have":
Leadership: Serving leadership and self-organization and their frameworks are familiar to you and you are keen to embark on this journey with us.

OUR TECH STACK

React, TypeScript on the frontend
Cypress & Jest
Python
Serverless architecture
AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora (Postgresql), Cognito, S3
GPT3 (Initial models)

ICING ON THE CAKE (BENEFITS)

Ingenieur:

Sie verfügen über:
ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Diplom/Bachelor) der Fachrichtung Maschinenbau, Umweltingenieurwesen, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Bauingenieurwesen oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung,
grundlegende Kenntnisse im Umweltschutzrecht sowie praktische Erfahrungen innerhalb einer öffentlichen Verwaltung?
Dann bietet Ihnen die Bezirksregierung Detmold eine interessante berufliche Perspektive!
Die Bezirksregierung Detmold vereinigt als Mittelbehörde die wichtigsten Fachaufgaben fast aller Landesministerien. Dadurch ist es uns möglich, bei Themen, die viele Fachaufgaben berühren effizient zwischen den Interessen der Landesregierung und denen der Bürger: innen, Kommunen und Wirtschaft im Regierungsbezirk Detmold zu vermitteln. Die vielfältigen Fachbereiche Ordnungsrecht, Gesundheit, Sozialwesen, Gefahrenabwehr, Verkehr, regionale Entwicklung, Kommunalaufsicht, Wirtschaft, Schule, Umwelt und Arbeitsschutz sind alle in unserer Behörde angesiedelt. Unsere Aufgaben umfassen somit fast alle Bereiche Ihres täglichen Lebens!
Was bieten wir Ihnen?
interessante, vielseitige und anspruchsvolle Aufgaben
attraktive Fortbildungs- und Weiterqualifizierungsmöglichkeiten sowohl für die persönliche als auch fachliche Weiterentwicklung u. a. in der Fortbildungsakademie des Landes NRW

Bereitschaft zu einem Einsatz in weiteren Aufgabenfeldern, bspw. in dezernatsübergreifenden Tätigkeitsbereichen
Die Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit zur Durchführung von Dienstreisen, auch als Fahrer: in von Dienstwagen, ist zwingend erforderlich.
Einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich des Immissionsschutzes bzw. des anlagenbezogenen Umweltschutzes, verwaltungsrechtliche, umweltrechtliche und umwelttechnische Kenntnisse oder praktische Erfahrung in Fachplanungsbüros und im Projektmanagement (Planung und Genehmigung von Anlagen der Erneuerbaren Energien) werden vorausgesetzt.
Tätigkeitsfeld/Aufgabengebiete:
Der Ausbau der Erneuerbaren Energien soll im Regierungsbezirk beschleunigt werden. Mit der „Regional-Initiative Wind OWL“ arbeitet die Bezirksregierung eng mit den Kreisen in Ostwestfalen-Lippe und der kreisfreien Stadt Bielefeld zusammen. Die Bezirksregierung berät hierbei in rechtlichen und fachlichen Fragen und durch eine stärkere Standardisierung sollen die Genehmigungsverfahren verkürzt und optimiert werden.
Der Bezirksregierung Detmold obliegt darüber hinaus insbesondere die Durchführung von Genehmigungsverfahren mit Prüfung der Umweltverträglichkeit sowie die Überwachung von gewerblichen Anlagen. Hierbei werden auch Anlagen der Erneuerbaren Energien, z.B. Biogasanlagen, Windenergieanlagen und Photovoltaikanlagen, sofern sie unter das „Zaunprinzip“ fallen, direkt durch die Bezirksregierung genehmigt und überwacht. Weitere Aufgaben sind die Umsetzung der Anlagensicherheit im Sinne der Störfallverordnung und die Mitwirkung bei Luftreinhalte- sowie Lärmminderungsplänen.
In einem Team aus Fach- und Verwaltungsbeschäftigten sind Sie zuständig für die:
Beratung und Unterstützung der Kreise in OWL und der kreisfreien Stadt Bielefeld im Bereich der Erneuerbaren Energien, vorrangig der Windenergie,
Organisation und Durchführung von regelmäßigen Besprechungen, um aktuelle Frage- und Problemstellungen bei der Genehmigung von Windenergieanlagen sowie konkrete, schwierige Einzelfälle zu besprechen und Lösungen zu entwickeln,
Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung eines effektiven, digitalen Verfahrensmanagements,
Anfertigung von Berichten und Stellungnahmen,
Fachaufsicht über die unteren Umweltschutzbehörden bei den Kreisen und der kreisfreien Stadt Bielefeld,
Bearbeitung von Eingaben und Petitionen,
Mitarbeit in einer landesweiten Arbeitsgruppe zum beschleunigten Ausbau von Anlagen der Erneuerbaren Energien,
Aufgaben im Tätigkeitsbereich anlagenbezogener Immissionsschutz.

Bei fachlichen Fragen steht Ihnen Herr Samuel Düe, samuel.duee@bezreg-detmold.nrw.de, 05231/71-5307 gerne zur Verfügung.
Allgemeine Hinweise

SYSTEMIQ is a systems change company that partners with business, finance, policy-makers, and civil society to make economic systems truly sustainable. We combine high-level research with high-impact, on-the-ground work.
Our purpose is to catalyse good disruptions in critical economic systems, with a current focus that includes low-carbon energy, materials and the circular economy, and regenerative oceans and land use. These disruptions are not only vital to the future of humanity and our planet, they also open up immense opportunities for the businesses that drive them.
SYSTEMIQ connects the right people, ideas, technologies and capital to transform economic systems:
1. We convene and support coalitions of leaders to shape policies and business strategies that will rapidly transform economic activity
2. We work with pioneering companies that want to drive the change in their industry
3. We co-create and incubate the market solutions most likely to build regenerative economic systems
4. We invest our own venture capital and expertise to accelerate business innovation and drive system change
5. We direct larger pools of capital so that they are invested for long-term sustainability, and we work to accelerate the transformation to a greener, more inclusive financial system.
In order to deliver in these areas, we recruit and develop distinctive and varied individuals who strive to achieve our mission, challenge the status quo and act as change leaders.

The talent we need
You will be part of a growing global communications and engagement team and will work closely with Systemiq’s leadership, the CCO and the wider team to build out the internal communications capabilities for Systemiq. Develop and implement a comprehensive internal communications strategy that supports Systemiq’s mission, vision and strategic objectives.

Manage and optimise various internal communication channels, ensuring information is accessible and engaging for employees around the world.
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effective of internal communications efforts, gathering feedback from employees using insights to continuously improve communications strategies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent messaging and alignment across different departments and geographies.
You will leverage your international experience to ensure that communication strategies are culturally sensitive and effective in diverse regions.

Das Fraunhofer-Institut für Fabrikbetrieb und -automatisierung sucht zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für das Geschäftsfeld Energiesysteme und Infrastrukturen einen engagierten studentischen Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) zur Mitarbeit an aktuellen Forschungs- und Industrieprojekten mit Fokus auf die Untersuchung von Energie- und Versorgungssystemen.
In der Abteilung Energiesysteme und Infrastrukturen forschen wir für eine klimaneutrale Zukunft. Dazu gehören Technologien zur Planung, Überwachung, Steuerung und Schutz von Energieinfrastrukturen ebenso wie zur effizienten Umwandlung und nachhaltigen Bereitstellung von Energie.
Was Sie bei uns tun
Ausgehend von den klima- und energiepolitischen Zielen des Landes sowie dem notwendigen Transformationsprozess zu einer CO2-armen Wirtschaft sind innovative Verfahrensansätze notwendig. Der Aufbau einer Wasserstoffwirtschaft, basierend auf Sektorenkopplung, bietet hier einen elementaren Ansatz, diese Ziele zu erreichen.
Die Erzeugung von Wasserstoff mit Hilfe von erneuerbaren Energien stellt eine Möglichkeit dar den zukünftigen Bedarfen in Industrie und Gewerbe gerecht zu werden. Im Sinne einer nachhaltigen Kreislaufwirtschaft und Systemintegration bestehen jedoch weitere Möglichkeiten zur Erzeugung von Wasserstoff. Hierzu gehören insbesondere biologische Prozesse, wie die Dunkelfermentation oder die Biomassevergasung, bei denen ein Wasserstoff-haltiges Produktgemisch entsteht.

Wir vom Fraunhofer-Institut für Verfahrenstechnik und Verpackung - IVV - mit Standorten in Freising und Dresden - sind führend in der Forschung und Entwicklung in unseren Geschäftsfeldern Lebensmittel, Verpackung, Produktwirkung, Verarbeitungsmaschinen sowie Recycling und Umwelt. In unserer täglichen Arbeit beschäftigen wir uns mit aktuellen Herausforderungen der von uns adressierten Branchen und treiben die Zukunftsthemen Bioökonomie, Kreislaufwirtschaft, Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden sowie Sicherheit und Resilienz voran.
Wir am Fraunhofer IVV in Freising suchen Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für die Abteilung "Verfahrensentwicklung Lebensmittel" als
DOKTORAND*IN für den Bereich "Texturierung pflanzlicher Biopolymere"
Die Abteilung "Verfahrensentwicklung Lebensmittel" entwickelt qualitativ hochwertige, gesunde und innovative Lebensmittel. Ausgehend von der Produktidee über Modellrezepturen, Verfahrenskonzepte und Musterproduktionen bis zum Scale-up des Herstellungsprozesses marktreifer Produkte in den Industriemaßstab betrachten wir alle Entwicklungsphasen. Dabei forschen wir an Wechselwirkungen von Rezeptur, Prozess und Produkteigenschaften sowie deren Einfluss auf die Produktqualität.
Die Gruppe "texturierte Lebensmittel" beschäftigt sich mit Forschungs- und Entwicklungsvorhaben im Bereich der Texturierung pflanzlicher Biopolymere, wie z.B. pflanzlichen Proteine, Stärke oder Ballaststoffe. Der Fokus liegt dabei auf der Strukturierung und Funktionalisierung von Rohstoffen sowie Lebensmittelnebenströmen für den Einsatz in neuartigen Lebensmitteln, wie beispielsweise in Fleischersatzprodukten oder gesunden Snackalternativen.
Was Sie bei uns tun
Eingebunden in ein hochmotiviertes, innovatives und fachübergreifendes Team bearbeiten Sie vielseitige Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte von regionaler bis internationaler Reichweite. Der Fokus Ihrer Arbeit liegt auf der eigenständigen Forschung an einem aktuellen wissenschaftlichen Themengebiet im Bereich der Texturierung pflanzlicher Proteine mit dem Ziel der Promotion.
Beginnend mit ausführlichen Recherchen in wissenschaftlichen, einschlägigen Datenbanken, umfassen Ihre praktischen Tätigkeiten die Planung und Durchführung der Labor- und Technikumsarbeiten, die Betreuung von studentischen Arbeiten und Geräten bis hin zur Ergebnisauswertung und -präsentation auf wissenschaftlichen Fachtagungen. Dabei stehen Sie im Kontakt mit verschiedenen Forschungspartnern, verfasst Projektberichte und veröffentlichen Sie ihre Ergebnisse in wissenschaftlich relevanten peer-reviewed Journals.

Idealerweise zusätzliche Qualifikationen in Extrusion, Maschinenbau, Textiltechnologie oder Rheologie

Kaufleute für Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung organisieren den Versand, Umschlag und ggf. die Lagerung von Gütern und überwachen das Zusammenwirken der an einer Logistikkette Beteiligten: Abfallerzeuger, Fracht- bzw. Verkehrs- und Umschlagsunternehmen, Aufbereitungs- und Entsorgungsanlagen. Sie beraten und betreuen Kunden, z.B. in der Wahl des geeigneten Transportmittels; sie kalkulieren Preise, arbeiten Angebote aus und bereiten Verträge zur Auftragserteilung vor. Sie bearbeiten Kundenreklamationen, nehmen Schadensmeldungen entgegen und kümmern sich um die Schadensregulierung. Ist ein Auftrag vollständig abgewickelt, werden die Daten zur Fakturierung übermittelt und entsprechend abgerechnet. Zu ihren Aufgaben kann auch das Ausarbeiten zusätzlicher Optionen der Logistikdienstleistungen gehören, z.B. die Optimierung, Übernahme vor- oder nachbereitender Aufgaben im Rahmen des Transportwesens.

Die chemische Industrie befindet sich in einem Transformationsprozess. Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich der Petrochemie hat die LyondellBasell diese Herausforderung angenommen. Speziell der Standort Wesseling im Kölner Raum spielt eine entscheidende Rolle beim Wandel in Richtung Nachhaltigkeit. Neben dem Einsatz von erneuerbaren Energien und der Reduktion von CO2 liegt der Kernfokus der kommenden Jahre auf Kreislaufwirtschaft. Dabei sind die drei Säulen zur Produktion von Rezyklat (Recover, Renew und Revive) am Standort vertreten und stellen die Geschäftsgrundlage der Zukunft dar. Wertschöpfungsgetriebene Anlagenoptimierungen unterstreichen den Wandel der Industrie und ebnen den Weg zur Nachhaltigkeit.
Für die im Jahr 2000 gebaute Produktionsanlage OG2 wird ein stellvertretender Betriebsleiter gesucht. In der OG2 werden jährlich bis zu 300 kt HDPE in einem Gasphasenwirbelschichtreaktor hergestellt. Der stellvertretende Betriebsleiter ist disziplinarischer Vorgesetzter des vollkontinuierlichen Schichtbetriebes, sowie fachlicher Vorgesetzter des Tagdienstes. Kernaufgabe ist die operative Führung des Tagesgeschäft. Dazu gehört die Überwachung der Anlage und die Untersuchung und Behebung von Störungen. Im Rahmen der kontinuierlichen Optimierung der Produktionsanlage werden Prozess- und Produktverbesserungen vorangetrieben oder Anlagenänderungen und strategische Projekte umgesetzt. Als stellvertretender Betreiber in einer BImSchG-Anlage ist die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderung eine weitere Kernaufgabe. Dazu gehört die Abwicklung interner und externer Audits, die Durchführung von Sicherheitsbetrachtungen (PHA), sowie die Untersuchung von Ereignissen. Als Führungskraft gestalten Sie maßgeblich die Grundpfeiler des Unternehmens. Dazu gehören die aktive Sicherheitskultur (Goal-Zero), der Transformationsgedanke, aber auch das Vorleben der DEI (Vielfalt, Gleichbehandlung, Zugehörigkeit)-Mentalität und die Entwicklung von Mitarbeitern.

Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft betreibt in Deutschland derzeit 76 Institute und Forschungseinrichtungen und ist die weltweit führende Organisation für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. Rund 30 000 Mitarbeitende erarbeiten das jährliche Forschungsvolumen von 2,9 Milliarden Euro.
Wir vom Fraunhofer-Institut für Verfahrenstechnik und Verpackung IVV – mit Standorten in Freising und Dresden – sind führend in der Forschung und Entwicklung in unseren Geschäftsfeldern Lebensmittel, Verpackung, Produktwirkung, Verarbeitungsmaschinen sowie Recycling und Umwelt. In unserer täglichen Arbeit beschäftigen wir uns mit aktuellen Herausforderungen der von uns adressierten Branchen und treiben die Zukunftsthemen Bioökonomie und Kreislaufwirtschaft, Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden sowie Sicherheit und Resilienz voran.
Das Fraunhofer IVV in Freising sucht Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als
Technische*r Angestellte*r – Chemische Technologie / Extrusion
Die Abteilung »Verfahrensentwicklung Polymer-Recycling« beschäftigt sich mit der Rückgewinnung von Wertstoffen aus kunststoffhaltigen Abfällen. Unser Entwicklungsziel sind industrielle Verfahren, die mit hervorragender Reinigungseffizienz unter wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen saubere Kunststoff-Recyclate und/oder metallische Wertstoffe produzieren. Um die Nachhaltigkeit moderner Kunststoffverpackungen und Komposite zu verbessern, bearbeiten wir aktuell Recyclingprojekte im industriellen und öffentlichen Auftrag. Die Verfahrensentwicklung erfolgt mit dem mehrstufigen Scale-up vom Labor- bis zum technischen Maßstab. Entwicklungsbegleitend werden vielfältige spurenanalytische Methoden eingesetzt. Wir suchen Sie für den Ausbau unseres Technikums im Bereich »Anlagenrealisierung Polymer-Recycling« und für die Mitarbeit an laufenden Umsetzungsprojekten.
Was Sie bei uns tun
Bearbeitung von Projekten zu (lösemittelbasierten) Kunststoffrecyclingprozessen im Technikum des Instituts
Übertragung von Laborprozessen in den technischen Maßstab
Dokumentation und Aufbereitung der Ergebnisse in enger Abstimmung mit der jeweiligen Projektleitung
Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung von Maschinen und Anlagen, inklusive Fehlersuche und Fehlerbehebung
Was Sie mitbringen
Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich chemische Technologie, Kunststoff- oder Verfahrenstechnik, Verfahrensmechanik oder alternativ eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum/zur Techniker*in, Industriemechaniker*in oder Chemikant*in.
Sie haben eine eigenständige, vorausschauende, strukturierte, zuverlässige und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Arbeit im Team.
Sie besitzen apparatetechnische und chemische Kenntnisse sowie einschlägige Erfahrung im Umgang mit Apparaturen und Anlagen im Labor- und Technikumsmaßstab.
Sie besitzen zudem die Fähigkeit, sich schnell und mit eigenen Ideen in neue Problemstellungen einzuarbeiten.
Erfahrung mit Kunststoff-Extrusion bzw. im Umgang mit Kunststoffen und hochviskosen Flüssigkeiten ist von Vorteil.
Was Sie erwarten können
Eine hervorragende technische Ausstattung im kleintechnischen Maßstab sowie im Pilotanlagen- und Demonstrationsmaßstab.
Ein kreatives und interdisziplinäres Arbeitsumfeld in einem hoch motivierten Team, in dem sich erfahrene Expert*innen und Nachwuchskräfte unterstützen und verstärken
Darüber hinaus erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit zur individuellen Entwicklung durch ein vielfältiges Weiterbildungsangebot.
Nicht zuletzt bieten wir Ihnen eine flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung zur besseren Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf.
Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. ÜBER UNS
Die Wurzer Umwelt Unternehmensgruppe wurde vor über 35 Jahren von der Familie Wurzer gegründet und ist für inzwischen über 450 Mitarbeiter*innen ein stabiler regionaler Arbeitgeber. In den Bereichen Landschaftspflege, Entsorgung, Recycling, Logistik und Energiegewinnung spielt für uns das Thema „Umwelt“ eine zentrale Rolle.
Im Sinne einer nachhaltigen und umweltschonenden Kreislaufwirtschaft leistet jede/r Einzelne von uns tagtäglich einen kleinen Beitrag, dass auch die Generation von morgen Bayern so schön erleben darf, wie wir.
NOCH UNSICHER?
Die Entscheidung, welcher Ausbildungsberuf der passende für dich ist, ist oft nicht einfach. Ein Schnuppertag bei uns kann dir dabei helfen.
Während deines Schnuppertages erhältst du gemeinsam mit anderen Schüler*innen einen Einblick in die verschiedensten Bereiche bei der Wurzer Umwelt Unternehmensgruppe und somit in deinen (vielleicht) zukünftigen Ausbildungsberuf.
Bei unseren technischen Berufen zeigen wir dir gerne unsere Maschinen und Anlagen, an denen du während einer Ausbildung auch eingesetzt wirst. Im kaufmännischen Bereich kannst du dir einen ersten Überblick über die vielfältigen Aufgabenbereiche machen.
Außerdem lernst du das Team vor Ort schon einmal kennen, das dir bei deinem Schnuppertag für all deine Fragen zur Seite steht.

job_title_name: Consultant / Manager (m/f/d) in the field of Sustainable Finance, Madrid based (part-time/full-time)
job_description:
Consultant / Manager (m/f/d)
In the field of Sustainable Finance, Madrid based (part-time/full-time) // adelphi Consult
adelphi is Europe's leading independent think-and-do tank on climate, environment and development. As a leading policy consultancy, we advocate for just transformative change and a livable and sustainable society. 300 bright minds work locally and globally on environment and sustainability and the challenges of political, economic and social change.
Exciting tasks in a varied environment await you with us. Contribute your ideas and expertise to our interdisciplinary, international teams and benefit from networked working and learning as well as flat hierarchies.
PART TIME / FULL TIME
Madrid
Job summary
As a Consultant/Manager in adelphi’s Finance programme, your role is to support our project for international financial institutions (IFIs) and commercial banks in the successful implementation of sustainable finance strategies and programmes. Projects may include the development of climate action strategies, the implementation of credit lines for energy efficiency or renewable energy financing, the management of financing facilities that support clean-tech or biodiversity investments, and consulting on financial tools and products focusing on resource efficiency or circular economy.
Diversity is important to us. For a sustainable future, we need a diversity of experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.
Your tasks
Depending on your background and expertise, responsibilities may include the following:
conceptual design, development, and implementation of targeted and impactful expert support services, materials, trainings, and tools for financial institutions
management of international projects including contract, budget, and deliverable management
delivery of high-quality expert advice regarding sustainable finance processes and tools, financial product development and market assessments, sustainable project and loan pipeline development, or the development of capacities for sustainable financing
coordination of internal and external teams of consultants and colleagues
Regular exchange with clients such as IFIs and commercial banks
quality assurance and compliance with project terms
Further, as a colleague in our Finance programme, you contribute to the strategic orientation and further development of our sustainable finance services; you manage and write successful proposals and participate in other business development activities; you guide and advise junior team members; and you exchange with your colleagues on a regular basis to continuously advance our team’s expertise, quality of services, and team spirit.
Your qualifications
Essential:
Minimum 3 to 5 years of work experience in the field of sustainable finance with a strong focus on project management and consulting
A university degree (or similar qualification)
Initial work experience in one or several thematic areas of sustainable finance, such as EU Taxonomy, TCFD, NFRD/CSRD, SFDR, climate risk assessment (for financial institutions)
Commitment to and sincere interest in sustainable finance, high motivation to advance national and international sustainable finance agenda’s in direct collaboration with international and national financial institutions, including commercial banks
good overview of recent sustainable finance trends and initiatives
Experience in the acquisition, development and implementation of consulting projects and in the design of training measures
A solution-, client-, and quality-oriented approach to work
Ability to oversee various activities at once ensuring timely and successful implementation
Creative team-player with strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as attention to detail;
Interest in a long-term collaboration in a dynamically working and growing team;
Excellent oral and written expression in Spanish and English
Willingness to occasionally travel to project countries for short-term stays
Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office suite of programmes
Desired:
Excellent oral and written expression additional languages such as Portuguese and/or French are an advantage
Experience in working for the financial sector either as consultant or directly is a strong plus
Experience in the design and implementation of technical assistance/expert support for sustainability/green credit lines
Knowledge and experience in developing and running trainings to the financial sector
We offer...
A job with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to strengthen your profile and experience in sustainable finance and pro-actively shape your area of work
Possibility to strive creatively and shape impactful solutions for sustainable finance, quickly take on responsibility for projects and versatile tasks
Be part of a growing and dynamic sustainable finance team in an impact-oriented consulting company
Flat hierarchies and a flexible work environment as well as friendly and committed colleagues
Continuous advancement of your competencies, active work-life balance through flexible working hours and working time models, possibility to re-enter the space after leave or after work in other sectors
Attractive benefits (e.g. discounted Urban Sports Club membership)
Option to work partly remotely and partly at easily accessible co-working space in Madrid
The position is initially limited to 2 years. If the cooperation is successful, we will have a strong interest to transform it into a permanent position.
Your application
We therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality or ethnic and social origin. Recognised severely disabled persons or persons of equal status will be given preferential consideration in the case of equal suitability.
Please send a full application including cover letter, CV, references and further documents you deem relevant.
Please use only the way via our online application

job_title_name: PhD Researcher (f/m/x) - Managing soil microbiomes for sustainable agriculture
job_description:
Place of work
Leipzig
Working time
65 % (25,35 h / week)
Contract limitations
limited contract / 36 months
Salary
Remuneration according to the TVöD public-sector up to pay grade EG 13 including attractive public-sector social security benefits.
Contact
Your contact for any questions you may have about the job:
Dr. Anja Worrich
anja.worrich@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
The UFZ offers four PhD positions in the framework of the PhD college “Coupling circular economy principles with environmental hazard management for liquid manure-based sustainable agriculture- SmartManure”. The aim of SmartManure is to address on-farm manure management from storage to land application, combining aspects of circular economy with sustainable agriculture, and develop technical solutions based on the joint research within the PhD college (see https://www.ufz.de/Smartmanure for more information).
Your tasks
Intensive crop production in agriculture contributes to a decline in soil microbial diversity, which is crucial for soil health and food safety as it acts as insurance against stressors. In this subproject of SmartManure you will identify suitable cover crops that stimulate the soil microbiome to become more resilient to manure-related hazards, while improving nutrient retention from applied manure.
Your tasks will be to:
Design and conduct pot experiments and field trials with different cover crops.
Analyze shifts in microbial diversity and composition in the soils.
Track antibiotics, antibiotic resistance genes and heavy metals in the soils.
Determine nutrient retention from manure and changes in nitrate leaching and greenhouse gas emission.
Analyze and statistically evaluate data.
Participate in the UFZ graduate school HIGRADE with options for targeted training.
Publish the results (peer-reviewed papers, national and international conferences).
Collaborate with all other PhD candidates of SmartManure.
Interact with stakeholders such as farmers and agencies.
We offer
Excellent technical facilities which are without parallel
The freedom you need to bridge the difficult gap between basic research and close to being ready for application
Work in inter-disciplinary, multinational teams
Excellent links with national and international research networks
Excellent support and optimal subject-specific and general training with our HIGRADE graduate school
Your profile
Master's degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biology, Environmental Science or a related field
Readiness for intensive field work
Skills in data evaluation (e.g. R)
High motivation and teamplayer skills are expected
Excellent communication skills (English required)
Ability to work independently and motivated to work in an interdisciplinary team
Additional skills are of added value
Preference will be given to people highly interested in soil microbiology and molecular biology
Driving licence in Germany
Experience in microbial community analysis
Knowledge of plant-based research and conducting greenhouse and field trials
Application deadline: 31.01.2024

diversity
and actively supports
equal opportunities
for all employees regardless of their origin, religion, ideology, disability, age or sexual identity.
We look forward to applications from people who are open-minded and enjoy working in diverse teams.

photo

Contact

elisa.rojo-nieto@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
Within the new PhD cohort nanoINHALE (“Impacts on ecosystem functions and human health by environmental plastics and associated chemicals”, see www.ufz.de/nanoinhale) at UFZ we offer four PhD positions. In nanoINHALE we aim to unravel the importance of the largely unknown plastics inhalation mechanism for (1) nanoplastics and (2) plastic-associated chemicals in air-breathing mammals, (3) identify major emission sources and transport pathways and (4) track the impacts of health risk narratives on plastic and air quality regulations. Overall, nanoINHALE aims to contribute knowledge towards a sustainable circular economy of plastics. Position (2) will be filled in the Department of Exposure Science.
Your tasks
The successful candidate will study plastic-associated chemicals in lung tissues and storage lipids of wild biota from terrestrial environments with different expected exposure to micro- and nanoplastics, in different but closely related species. The candidate will also characterize impacts of particle size on the leaching of plastic-associated chemicals in artificial lung fluids. The influence of the surface area/volume ratio on leaching will be evaluated, as well as how different sizes affect the penetrability into the lung system and thus the potential residence time. In addition, they will investigate how changes in the lung proteome of the studied biota correlate with the presence of plastic-associated chemicals, discerning potential pathways along which these chemicals can act.
You establish extraction methods for biota tissues, improve the existing analytical methods for the analysis of plastic-associated chemicals, and apply them to samples from different species and tissues. This work will be closely related to PhD #1, studying the same samples with complementary focus, and PhD #3, with some of the results feeding into the modeling.
You carry out experiments to study the leaching behavior of chemicals from model plastics into artificial lung fluid, studying kinetic and equilibrium modes. This work will be related to PhD#4, where some results will work as guidance for data interpretation and further outreach.
You investigate how changes in the lung proteome of the studied biota correlate with the presence of plastic-associated chemicals.
You write publications for peer-reviewed scientific journals about your results and present them at international conferences.
You communicate and disseminate research results to diverse audiences, e.g. private sector, public sector, students, civil society.

job_description:

Contract limitations

Salary
Remuneration according to the TVöD public-sector up to pay grade 13 including attractive public-sector social security benefits.
Contact
Your contact for any questions you may have about the job:
Dr. Dušan Materić
dusan.materic@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
Within the new PhD cohort nanoINHALE ("Impacts on ecosystem functions and human health by environmental plastics and associated chemicals", see www.ufz.de/nanoinhale) at UFZ we offer four PhD positions. In nanoINHALE we aim to unravel the importance of the largely unknown plastics inhalation mechanism for (1) nanoplastics and (2) plastic-associated chemicals in air-breathing mammals, (3) identify major emission sources and transport pathways and (4) track the impacts of health risk narratives on plastic and air quality regulations. Overall, nanoINHALE aims to contribute knowledge towards a sustainable circular economy of plastics. Position (1) will be filled in the Department of Environmental Analytical Chemistry.
Your tasks
The successful candidate will measure and study nanoplastics levels in environmental and biota samples using TD-PTR-MS. The overall goal is to make a link (if it exists) between nanoplastics loads in the lung tissue of wild animals and their natural environment.
You will optimise the method for measuring nanoplastics in lung tissue and apply it to a unique set of samples of different species of biota.
You will measure airborne nanoplastics concentrations and identify the sources linking the animal habitat and its exposure. This will require fieldwork and sampling.
You will write publications about your results for peer-reviewed scientific journals and present them at international conferences.
You will communicate and disseminate research results to diverse audiences, e.g. private sector, public sector, students, civil society.
Your work will be closely related to PhD #2 and #3.
We offer
Excellent technical facilities which are without parallel
The freedom you need to bridge the difficult gap between basic research and close to being ready for application
Work in inter-disciplinary, multinational teams
Excellent links with national and international research networks
Excellent support and optimal subject-specific and general training with our HIGRADE graduate school
Your profile
A master's degree in Analytical Chemistry, Physics, Environmental Chemistry, Environmental Sciences or similar,
Experience in laboratory work and chemical analysis,
Coding skills in PYTHON, R or similar is strongly advantageous,
Experience with biota analysis and/or environmental studies is beneficial,
Experience in atmospheric sampling and analysis is advantageous,
Excellent communication skills (fluent English mandatory),
You are a team player but can work independently and in a self-organised way,
Motivation to work in an interdisciplinary, international team,
Some knowledge of German is helpful for navigating life in Germany but not required for the job.

Contact

Dr. Paniz Izadi
paniz.izadi@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
The UFZ offers four PhD positions in the framework of the PhD college “Coupling circular economy principles with environmental hazard management for liquid manure-based sustainable agriculture- SmartManure”. The aim of SmartManure is to address on-farm manure management from storage to land application, combining aspects of circular economy with sustainable agriculture, and develop technical solutions based on the joint research within the PhD college (see https://www.ufz.de/Smartmanure for more information).
Your tasks
Liquid manure produces significant amounts of the greenhouse gases CH4 and CO2 during storage on farms. Converting these into value-added chemicals will benefit the environment and contribute to circular economic goals. In this SmartManure subproject, we will develop an electrochemical system for the conversion of released CO2 to valuable chemicals and energy carriers particularly methanol.
Your tasks include:
discovering efficient catalysts for electrochemical conversion of CO2 to methanol,
establishing an electrochemical platform for reducing CO2 to allow on-farm liquid manure storage,
experimental validation and engineering of electrochemical CO2 reduction to methanol at biocompatible conditions,
set-up, validation and conduction of methods and protocols needed for the development of process lines and integration,
transfer to technical lab scale and assessment of system parameters through early-stage life cycle assessment,
method development and use of physical and chemical analysis, especially HPLC and GC,
participate in the UFZ graduate school HIGRADE with options for targeted training
collaborate with all other PhD candidates of SmartManure
providing high quality scientific outputs in the form of journal publications and assisting technology transfer.

Excellent technical facilities which are without parallel
The freedom you need to bridge the difficult gap between basic research and close to being ready for application
Work in inter-disciplinary, multinational teams
Excellent links with national and international research networks
Excellent support and optimal subject-specific and general training with our HIGRADE graduate school

Master’s degree in Chemistry, Bioengineering, Chemical engineering, Environmental Sciences or related fields,
Experience in process development is advantageous,
Readiness for intensive material and process development,
High motivation and team player skills are expected,
Excellent communication skills (English required),
Ability to work independently and motivated to work in an interdisciplinary team.
Additional skills are of added value:

job_description:

Remuneration according to the TVöD public-sector up to pay grade EG 13 including attractive public-sector social security benefits.
Contact
Your contact for any questions you may have about the job:
Qiuguo Fu
qiuguo.fu@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
The UFZ offers four PhD positions in the framework of the PhD college “Coupling circular economy principles with environmental hazard management for liquid manure-based sustainable agriculture- SmartManure”. The aim of SmartManure is to address on-farm manure management from storage to land application, combining aspects of circular economy with sustainable agriculture, and develop technical solutions based on the joint research within the PhD college (see https://www.ufz.de/Smartmanure for more information).
Your tasks
The intensive use of manure as fertilizer can lead to heavy metal and antibiotics accumulation in soils. Consequently, methods and processes need to be developed to selectively extract heavy metals and remove antibiotics from manure during its storage to obtain safe fertilizers. In this SmartManure subproject, a two-stage process will be devised that combines electrosorption and microbial electrochemistry for simultaneously recovering heavy metals and degrading antibiotics during on-site manure storage.
Your tasks are:
to devise a reactor that combines electrosorption and microbial electrochemistry,
to benchmark the developed prototype with a synthetic medium,
to adapt the reactor and process parameters to allow treatment of real manure,
to develop analytical methods to quantify removal of heavy metals and antibiotics and further identify transformation byproducts of antibiotics,
to analyze and statistically evaluate data,
to participate in the UFZ graduate school HIGRADE with options for targeted training,
to publish the results (peer-reviewed papers, national and international conferences),
to collaborate with all other PhD candidates of SmartManure,
to interact with stakeholders such as farmers and agencies.

Excellent technical facilities which are without parallel
The freedom you need to bridge the difficult gap between basic research and close to being ready for application
Work in inter-disciplinary, multinational teams
Excellent links with national and international research networks
Excellent support and optimal subject-specific and general training with our HIGRADE graduate school

Master degree or equivalent in biochemistry, biotechnology, electrochemistry, process engineering, or related natural sciences,
Knowledge and laboratory skills in basic electrochemical methods and analytical chemistry are advantageous,
Experimental creativity and hands-on problem-solving attitude is a prerequisite,
Strong self-motivation for independent scientific work in an interdisciplinary project and high reliability and resilience are required,
Proficient in English speaking and writing,
Excellent communication and teamwork skills

TOMRA was founded in 1972, based on the design, manufacturing and sale of reverse vending machines (RVMs) for automated collection of used beverage containers. Today TOMRA provides technology-led solutions for transforming how society and industries obtain, use and reuse the planet’s resources to enable a world without waste.
The company’s collection and sorting technology supports the transition to a circular economy, optimizes resource recovery and minimizes waste in the food, recycling, and mining industries. TOMRA turns complex challenges into valuable solutions and enables companies to transform into more profitable, sustainable businesses.
TOMRA has approximately 100,000 installations in over 80 markets worldwide and had total revenues of ~12,2 billion NOK in 2022. The Group employs ~5000 globally and is publicly listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. The company headquarters are in Asker, Norway.

job_description:
Consultant / Manager (m/f/d)
In the field of Sustainable Finance, Madrid based (part-time/full-time) // adelphi Consult
adelphi is Europe's leading independent think-and-do tank on climate, environment and development. As a leading policy consultancy, we advocate for just transformative change and a livable and sustainable society. 300 bright minds work locally and globally on environment and sustainability and the challenges of political, economic and social change.
Exciting tasks in a varied environment await you with us. Contribute your ideas and expertise to our interdisciplinary, international teams and benefit from networked working and learning as well as flat hierarchies.
PART TIME / FULL TIME
Madrid
Job summary
As a Consultant/Manager in adelphi’s Finance programme, your role is to support our project for international financial institutions (IFIs) and commercial banks in the successful implementation of sustainable finance strategies and programmes. Projects may include the development of climate action strategies, the implementation of credit lines for energy efficiency or renewable energy financing, the management of financing facilities that support clean-tech or biodiversity investments, and consulting on financial tools and products focusing on resource efficiency or circular economy.
Diversity is important to us. For a sustainable future, we need a diversity of experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.
Your tasks
Depending on your background and expertise, responsibilities may include the following:
conceptual design, development, and implementation of targeted and impactful expert support services, materials, trainings, and tools for financial institutions
management of international projects including contract, budget, and deliverable management
delivery of high-quality expert advice regarding sustainable finance processes and tools, financial product development and market assessments, sustainable project and loan pipeline development, or the development of capacities for sustainable financing
coordination of internal and external teams of consultants and colleagues
Regular exchange with clients such as IFIs and commercial banks
quality assurance and compliance with project terms
Further, as a colleague in our Finance programme, you contribute to the strategic orientation and further development of our sustainable finance services; you manage and write successful proposals and participate in other business development activities; you guide and advise junior team members; and you exchange with your colleagues on a regular basis to continuously advance our team’s expertise, quality of services, and team spirit.
Your qualifications
Essential:
Minimum 3 to 5 years of work experience in the field of sustainable finance with a strong focus on project management and consulting
A university degree (or similar qualification)
Initial work experience in one or several thematic areas of sustainable finance, such as EU Taxonomy, TCFD, NFRD/CSRD, SFDR, climate risk assessment (for financial institutions)
Commitment to and sincere interest in sustainable finance, high motivation to advance national and international sustainable finance agenda’s in direct collaboration with international and national financial institutions, including commercial banks
good overview of recent sustainable finance trends and initiatives
Experience in the acquisition, development and implementation of consulting projects and in the design of training measures
A solution-, client-, and quality-oriented approach to work
Ability to oversee various activities at once ensuring timely and successful implementation
Creative team-player with strong analytical and conceptual skills as well as attention to detail;
Interest in a long-term collaboration in a dynamically working and growing team;
Excellent oral and written expression in Spanish and English
Willingness to occasionally travel to project countries for short-term stays
Very good knowledge of Microsoft Office suite of programmes
Desired:
Excellent oral and written expression additional languages such as Portuguese and/or French are an advantage
Experience in working for the financial sector either as consultant or directly is a strong plus
Experience in the design and implementation of technical assistance/expert support for sustainability/green credit lines
Knowledge and experience in developing and running trainings to the financial sector
We offer...
A job with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to strengthen your profile and experience in sustainable finance and pro-actively shape your area of work
Possibility to strive creatively and shape impactful solutions for sustainable finance, quickly take on responsibility for projects and versatile tasks
Be part of a growing and dynamic sustainable finance team in an impact-oriented consulting company
Flat hierarchies and a flexible work environment as well as friendly and committed colleagues
Continuous advancement of your competencies, active work-life balance through flexible working hours and working time models, possibility to re-enter the space after leave or after work in other sectors
Attractive benefits (e.g. discounted Urban Sports Club membership)
Option to work partly remotely and partly at easily accessible co-working space in Madrid
The position is initially limited to 2 years. If the cooperation is successful, we will have a strong interest to transform it into a permanent position.
Your application

Contact

Dr. Anja Worrich
anja.worrich@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
The UFZ offers four PhD positions in the framework of the PhD college “Coupling circular economy principles with environmental hazard management for liquid manure-based sustainable agriculture- SmartManure”. The aim of SmartManure is to address on-farm manure management from storage to land application, combining aspects of circular economy with sustainable agriculture, and develop technical solutions based on the joint research within the PhD college (see https://www.ufz.de/Smartmanure for more information).
Your tasks
Intensive crop production in agriculture contributes to a decline in soil microbial diversity, which is crucial for soil health and food safety as it acts as insurance against stressors. In this subproject of SmartManure you will identify suitable cover crops that stimulate the soil microbiome to become more resilient to manure-related hazards, while improving nutrient retention from applied manure.
Your tasks will be to:
Design and conduct pot experiments and field trials with different cover crops.
Analyze shifts in microbial diversity and composition in the soils.
Track antibiotics, antibiotic resistance genes and heavy metals in the soils.
Determine nutrient retention from manure and changes in nitrate leaching and greenhouse gas emission.
Analyze and statistically evaluate data.
Participate in the UFZ graduate school HIGRADE with options for targeted training.
Publish the results (peer-reviewed papers, national and international conferences).
Collaborate with all other PhD candidates of SmartManure.
Interact with stakeholders such as farmers and agencies.
We offer
Excellent technical facilities which are without parallel
The freedom you need to bridge the difficult gap between basic research and close to being ready for application
Work in inter-disciplinary, multinational teams
Excellent links with national and international research networks
Excellent support and optimal subject-specific and general training with our HIGRADE graduate school

Master's degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biology, Environmental Science or a related field

High motivation and teamplayer skills are expected
Excellent communication skills (English required)

Additional skills are of added value
Preference will be given to people highly interested in soil microbiology and molecular biology

job_title_name: PhD Researcher (f/m/x) - Plastic-associated chemicals in ter-restrial biota, including simulated leaching
job_description:
Place of work
Leipzig
Working time
65 % (25,35 h / week)
Contract limitations
limited contract / 36 months
Salary
Remuneration according to the TVöD public-sector up to pay grade 13 including attractive public-sector social security benefits.
Contact
Your contact for any questions you may have about the job:
Dr. Elisa Rojo-Nieto
elisa.rojo-nieto@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
Within the new PhD cohort nanoINHALE (“Impacts on ecosystem functions and human health by environmental plastics and associated chemicals”, see www.ufz.de/nanoinhale) at UFZ we offer four PhD positions. In nanoINHALE we aim to unravel the importance of the largely unknown plastics inhalation mechanism for (1) nanoplastics and (2) plastic-associated chemicals in air-breathing mammals, (3) identify major emission sources and transport pathways and (4) track the impacts of health risk narratives on plastic and air quality regulations. Overall, nanoINHALE aims to contribute knowledge towards a sustainable circular economy of plastics. Position (2) will be filled in the Department of Exposure Science.
Your tasks
The successful candidate will study plastic-associated chemicals in lung tissues and storage lipids of wild biota from terrestrial environments with different expected exposure to micro- and nanoplastics, in different but closely related species. The candidate will also characterize impacts of particle size on the leaching of plastic-associated chemicals in artificial lung fluids. The influence of the surface area/volume ratio on leaching will be evaluated, as well as how different sizes affect the penetrability into the lung system and thus the potential residence time. In addition, they will investigate how changes in the lung proteome of the studied biota correlate with the presence of plastic-associated chemicals, discerning potential pathways along which these chemicals can act.
You establish extraction methods for biota tissues, improve the existing analytical methods for the analysis of plastic-associated chemicals, and apply them to samples from different species and tissues. This work will be closely related to PhD #1, studying the same samples with complementary focus, and PhD #3, with some of the results feeding into the modeling.
You carry out experiments to study the leaching behavior of chemicals from model plastics into artificial lung fluid, studying kinetic and equilibrium modes. This work will be related to PhD#4, where some results will work as guidance for data interpretation and further outreach.
You investigate how changes in the lung proteome of the studied biota correlate with the presence of plastic-associated chemicals.
You write publications for peer-reviewed scientific journals about your results and present them at international conferences.
You communicate and disseminate research results to diverse audiences, e.g. private sector, public sector, students, civil society.

Über uns
encory ist der Treiber für die Circular Economy. Wir beraten unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Kreislaufprozessen. Durch die Aufbereitung und Wiederverwendung von wertvollen Produktionsteilen verlängern wir Produktlebenszyklen und transformieren lineare Wirtschaftsprozesse zu einem zirkulären System. Das spart Geld und Energie – und damit auch CO2. So machen wir bei encory die Arbeitsabläufe unserer Kunden gleichzeitig profitabler und nachhaltiger.
Wir verstehen Diversität und Inklusion in all ihren Dimensionen als Stärke für unsere Teams. Chancengleichheit ist uns ein besonderes Anliegen, die Gleichbehandlung von Bewerber:innen sowie Mitarbeiter:innen ein grundlegendes Prinzip unserer Unternehmenspolitik. Daher basieren auch unsere Recruiting-Entscheidungen auf ihrer Persönlichkeit, ihren Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten.

Systemiq, the
systems change company
and certified B Corp, was founded to drive the achievement of the UN Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement on climate change by transforming markets and business models in five key systems: nature and food, materials, and circular economy, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.
We are guided by the conviction that all system transformations are rooted in human transformations. We must continue to bring more diverse people and voices into real conversations to succeed. We know we don’t have all the answers; we may not even have all the right questions. But we know that open mindsets drive change, so relationships, people, and trust are at the heart of everything we do.
Position:
Do you want to be part of the change?
As an Automotive & Mobility project manager, you will be instrumental in driving some of our key projects in the interconnected sectors of road mobility and automotive, critical raw materials, and responsible supply chains. You will lead teams across multiple projects and manage multi-stakeholder relationships across government, NGO, and industry bodies. This workstream nurtures the intersectionality between our circular economy, energy, and smart cities teams and will draw expertise from around the organisation and amongst external partners. As such, we are looking for someone with experience in operating across a range of sectors with the ability to bring actors together from disparate groups to form alliances and deliver on creative solutions.
Primary Responsibilities
Co-create approaches with our partners/clients to overcome the perceived trade-offs between economic viability, ecosystem regeneration, social inclusion and wellbeing,
Lead a team of other System Change Leaders and support them to thrive in their work
Bring data together in a consistent way and perform analyses based on agreed questions for insights
Develop long-lasting and collaborative relationships with project partners and stakeholders
Provide strategic insights and develop practical solutions for successful transformations
Support these partners in monitoring, evaluating, and communicating their business model, vision, and impact

job_title_name: PhD Researcher (f/m/x) - Identify major emission sources and airborn transport pathways of nano-plastics
job_description:
The job
Within the new PhD cohort nanoINHALE (“Impacts on ecosystem functions and human health by environmental plastics and associated chemicals”, see www.ufz.de/nanoinhale) at UFZ we offer four PhD positions. In nanoINHALE we aim to unravel the importance of the largely unknown plastics inhalation mechanism for (1) nanoplastics and (2) plastic-associated chemicals in air-breathing mammals, (3) identify major emission sources and transport pathways and (4) track the impacts of health risk narratives on plastic and air quality regulations. Overall, nanoINHALE aims to contribute knowledge towards a sustainable circular economy of plastics. Position (3) will be filled in the Department of Research Data Management.
Place of work
Leipzig
Working time
65 % (25,35 h / week)
Contract limitations
limited contract / 36 months
Salary
Remuneration according to the TVöD public-sector up to pay grade 13 including attractive public-sector social security benefits.
Contact
Your contact for any questions you may have about the job:
Dr. Lennart Schüler
lennart.schueler@ufz.de
The UFZ
The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ) with its 1,100 employees has gained an excellent reputation as an international competence centre for environmental sciences. We are part of the largest scientific organisation in Germany, the Helmholtz association. Our mission: Our research seeks to find a balance between social development and the long-term protection of our natural resources.
The job
Within the new PhD cohort nanoINHALE (“Impacts on ecosystem functions and human health by environmental plastics and associated chemicals”, see www.ufz.de/nanoinhale) at UFZ we offer four PhD positions. In nanoINHALE we aim to unravel the importance of the largely unknown plastics inhalation mechanism for (1) nanoplastics and (2) plastic-associated chemicals in air-breathing mammals, (3) identify major emission sources and transport pathways and (4) track the impacts of health risk narratives on plastic and air quality regulations. Overall, nanoINHALE aims to contribute knowledge towards a sustainable circular economy of plastics. Position (3) will be filled in the Department of Research Data Management.
Your tasks
The successful candidate sets up the state-of-the-art atmosphere and transport models ICON & ICON-ART and applies them on supercomputers with input data from project partners.
You carry out explorative modelling to analyse how to identify major nanoplastic sources, e.g. through source-receptor relations, inverse modelling, or data assimilation,
You study the effects of weather patterns on nanoplastic sedimentation,
You help your project partners in estimating the impact of regulating singular nanoplastic sources on affected hotspot regions,
You write publications for peer-reviewed scientific journals about your results and present them at international conferences.
You communicate and disseminate research results to diverse audiences, e.g. private sector, public sector, students, civil society.
We offer
Excellent technical facilities which are without parallel
The freedom you need to bridge the difficult gap between basic research and close to being ready for application
Work in inter-disciplinary, multinational teams
Excellent links with national and international research networks
Excellent support and optimal subject-specific and general training with our HIGRADE graduate school
Your profile
A master degree in Physics, Meteorology, Mathematics, or related fields,
Experience in numerical modelling or atmospheric physics and programming is mandatory,
Experience with supercomputers or at least Linux systems is advantageous,
Excellent communication skills (fluent English mandatory),
You are a team player but can work independently and in a self-organized way,
Motivation to work in an interdisciplinary, international team,
Some knowledge of German is helpful for navigating life in Germany but not required for the job.
