This gives our products a perspective for many decades and you a job with a future.
From engineering to construction
We supply partial and complete plants for the thermal treatment of waste and sewage sludge from a single source. With proprietary technologies for incineration, steam generation and flue gas cleaning, we offer solutions along the entire process chains. So, in your daily work you are always involved in the big picture and have the opportunity to experience the fascination of plant engineering!
Free space & personal responsibility
We believe that highly qualified people need room for manoeuvre and freedom to develop their full potential. That is why you enjoy freedom of choice and a high degree of personal responsibility with us. Because you are the experts in your field and know best how to bring your projects forward.
Internationality & variety – every day
We are proud to be part of a global group of companies. This gives us the security and strength we need to realise complex large-scale international projects. Every contract is unique and you will benefit from a varied working day where you can always learn something new. No day is like the other and our routine is called variety.
Private & professional life in balance
We aim to help you achieve a good work-life balance – something that is also of particular concern to our works council! You can therefore look forward to flexible working hours with flexitime and a culture of mobile working, where you can work from home 40% a week in consultation with your supervisor. 30 days of annual leave are a standard at our company; in addition, you can expect up to four bridging days off per year. Overtime can be compensated for example with free time.
Together at eye level
We aim to be successful together – regardless of title or position. It is important to us to discuss with each other at eye level and to support good ideas. Our managers see themselves not only as your superiors, but also as your colleagues. We are convinced that this approach promotes creativity and cohesion at all levels.
Lentjes Family
We always give new colleagues a warm welcome and offer support wherever necessary. But even beyond onboarding, we are proud to say that you will be working with people you can really rely on and trust. From time to time, we also like to leave the daily work routine behind us to celebrate with our colleagues over cool drinks and a delicious buffet.
Cultural diversity
We are convinced that diversity is always an enrichment and that diversity positively influences success. Therefore, our company is characterised by cultural diversity and we are proud of that! We have colleagues from many different countries on board and live internationality not only in our projects.
Bicycle leasing
We encourage our employees to be active and therefore offer the possibility of leasing a bicycle (JobRad), which can of course be used privately. And there is a wide choice: whether mountain bike, Dutch bike or e-bike – almost any bike can become a JobRad. But that is not all: you can also lease additional bicycles for up to three family members.
Additional services for special private events
We celebrate extraordinary days in your life with you: If you tie the knot, for example, you can look forward to two additional days off and a small allowance to start your life together. If you are already celebrating your silver wedding anniversary, we will congratulate you with one additional day off. Is your family growing? What a happy occasion to present you with a small gift and to give you two extra days off!
Modern and air-conditioned working environment
We believe that a well-equipped working environment is elementary. Therefore, you can expect bright and friendly offices with air conditioning and an ergonomically equipped workplace.
Feel-good lounges
We believe that where work is done on complex projects and technologies, there must also be room for creative refuelling and personal exchange. Our cosy lounges therefore invite you to chat with colleagues over a cup of hot tea or a glass of latte macchiato or to have lunch together.
Gastronomic offer in the headquarter
We are pleased to offer you daily breakfast and lunch, freshly prepared in our canteen at the Ratingen site. In addition to meat dishes, our canteen always offers a vegetarian main course and fresh regional salads as well as sweet dessert options. In summer, we also like to meet in our beautiful inner courtyard with fountain to spend our lunch break together in the sun.
Free parking spaces
We strive to make it easy for you to get to work in the morning without having to search for a parking space. Whether you use the car or the bicycle – you will find a variety of free parking options in the outdoor or in the underground car park.

job_description:
29 countries. Around 45,000 colleagues. 70,000 pharmacies supplied and millions of patients: Join PHOENIX! Support us in supplying the people of Europe with medicines and healthcare products quickly and reliably - and experience a job that is as diverse as it is important. Where you can proactively master challenges, implement ideas and drive change. Look forward to pure variety at a successful, future-proof family company, the market-leading pharmaceutical retailer in Germany and at the same time the best integrated healthcare provider in Europe.
For our headquarter in Mannheim we are looking for a Sustainability Manager (m/f/d) with focus on Environmental Management.
Your Tasks
Establishment, introduction and continuous further development of a resource protection and circular economy strategy as well as a strategy for the reduction of environmental pollution (especially pollution of air) in order to meet the requirements of the CSRD, especially ESRS E2 and E5 in the future
Support in the further implementation of our climate strategy with the goal of becoming CO2 neutral by 2030 in our own business area (Scope 1+2) incl. annual collection of our Scope 3 emissions, as well as conducting an initial climate risk and resilience analysis
Evaluation of environmental, energy and emissions KPIs for performance monitoring and derivation of improvement potentials as well as project proposals in close cooperation with specialist departments and our European companies
Collaborate with all group companies and provide support/training, and share best practices to foster a culture of environmental sustainability across the organization
Establish concise and transparent lines of communication at all hierarchy level internally as well as externally, providing regular updates on the status of initiatives and strategy. Contribution to the annual sustainability reporting as well as to ratings like EcoVadis
You closely follow external requirements and evaluate them in the context of projects, consultations and benchmark analyses
Your Profile
Completed master's degree in environmental engineering, environmental and energy management, sustainability management or a related field
At least 5 years of professional experience in the management of projects and processes in an environmental protection context
Knowledge in management systems, especially in environmental and energy management (EMAS/ISO 14001/ISO 50001) as well as practical experience in the areas of circular economy and life cycle assessment, development and implementation of climate strategies, climate risk analysis and carbon accounting according to the GHG Protocol (Scope 1-3)
Effective analytical skills and high attention to detail, including the ability to develop business cases, supervise the development of analytics and metrics, set goals, and identify gaps and opportunities for new projects and programs
Passion for environmental sustainability, with pragmatic, value creating mindset and the ability to represent your personal motivation to the outside world at different hierarchy levels through a confident appearance and open communication. Excellent communication skills in German and English
For you, self-initiative and independent work are a matter. You demonstrate empathy and an openness to collaboration in a multicultural environment with a clear service focus
Willingness to take interim leadership of a small sustainability team
Our Benefits:
Future-proof:
We are growing and expanding. We are the market leader and offer you a permanent employment contract, 13 monthly salaries, vacation pay as well as 30 days of vacation and much more. (job bike, company pension scheme, etc.
Reconciliation of private and professional life:
We offer mobile office and flexible working time models.
Career:
We promote you! There are great opportunities within the PHOENIX Group.
Continuing education:
We would love to - we are happy if you are eager to learn. The PHOENIX Learning World offers you an exclusive range of further training courses.
Team:
This is how we work. We promote team cohesion through small and large events.

company_name: BASF Environmental Catalysts and Metal Solutions
job_description:
Global Chemical Regulations Specialist (m/f/d)
Hannover, DE, 30173
Leveraging its deep expertise as the global leader in catalysis and precious metals, BASF Environmental Catalyst and Metal Solutions (ECMS) serves customers in many industries including automotive, aerospace, indoor air quality, semiconductors and hydrogen economy, and provides full loop services with its precious metals trading and recycling offering. With a focus on circular solutions and sustainability, ECMS is committed to helping our customers create a cleaner, more sustainable world. Protecting our elements of life is our purpose and this inspires us to ever-new solutions. ECMS operates globally in 15 countries with approximately 20 production sites and over 4,000 employees.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Ensure compliance of a defined portfolio of ECMS materials with EU-REACH and other applicable global chemical regulations including REACH-like regulations by performing notifications and registrations if necessary.
Ensure license to operate for production and business by registration of new substances and identification of missing registrations and registration gaps.
Support and advise business units with regards to global chemical regulations, especially for REACH.
Represent ECMS in trade associations and consortia, preferably in EU.
Also Represent ECMS in discussion with ECHA and national authorities on REACH issues.
You closely follow policy/political developments in your area of responsibility and assess how and when such political developments/strategies change existing laws and directives. You assess impacts for ECMS, communicat these developments to Leadership in a timely manner and consider IT-based compliance tools.
Maintain relevant data in the used SAP EHS module and supporting EHS master data quality improvement.
Provide global chemical regulatory reporting.
Monitoring and management of chemical regulations in SAP-GTS system.
QUALIFICATIONS / REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s degree in natural sciences (chemistry preferred), Master’s or PhD degree preferably (chemistry desirable).
Minimum of 4 - 6 years professional experience in chemical or product regulations, including REACH.
Specific expertise in the EU-REACH Regulation and related IT-Systems like IUCLID, REACH-IT.
Specific expertise and in SAP EHS Master Data Systems.
Solid knowledge of global chemical regulations.
Experience and knowledge on Product Safety tasks is expected as well.
Business standard German (written and oral), very good knowledge in English.
Good communication skills and goal-oriented work style.
BENEFITS
Attractive salary with additional bonus option, based on company's success and your individual performance.
Development discussions and programs so that you can reach your full potential.
Pension program and employer-funded nursing care insurance.
Subsidies for the company fitness program at Hansefit and for childcare in a local care group.
Flexible work arrangements whenever possible.

Paper applications are also welcome, but please note that we do not return paper applications including folders. Address: BASF Catalysts Germany GmbH, Human Resources, Seligmannallee 1, D-30173 Hannover, Germany.

Our Technology
Doosan Lentjes offers proprietary environmental technologies for thermal waste and sewage sludge treatment and energy recovery. We deliver flexible solutions for long-term waste disposal security and climate-friendly steam and power generation.

Indispensable technologies

Lentjes Family

We believe that where work is done on complex projects and technologies, there must also be room for creative refuelling and personal exchange. Our cosy lounges therefore invite you to chat with colleagues over a cup of hot tea or a glass of latte macchiato or to have lunch together.

job_title_name: Postdoctoral Researcher / Scientist (f/m/d) in process hydrometallurgy and circular economy
job_description:
Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf e.V.
Through cutting-edge research in the fields of ENERGY, HEALTH and MATTER, Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf (HZDR) solves some of the pressing societal and industrial challenges of our time. Join our 1.500 employees from more than 70 nations at one of our six research sites!
At the Helmholtz Institute Freiberg for Resource Technology (HIF), innovative technologies for the circulareconomy are developed to provide and use mineral and metal-bearing rawmaterials more efficiently and to recycle them in an environmentally friendly way.
The Department of Metallurgy is looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher / Scientist (f/m/d) in process hydrometallurgy and circular economy.
Postdoctoral Researcher / Scientist (f/m/d) in process hydrometallurgy and circular economy
English
Working field:
Development of processes based on solution chemistry, speciations, membranes (supported or modified), hydrometallurgy with focus on technical and critical metals (Li, Co, Cu, Zn, V, Ni, REEs, In, Ge, Ga, etc) recovery through complex hydrometallurgical techniques and piloting.
Initiation of new multilateral and industrial projects on circular economy topic.
Applications of developed processes for different primary and secondary feeds for high purity metal recovery
Commissioning, supervision, operation and optimization of complex hydrometallurgical and membrane separation pilot plants.
Execution of supplementary metallurgical experiments on lab scale and scaling up further on pilot scale.
Willingness to closely cooperate with academic and industrial partners and other departments
Co-supervision of masters and PhD students, regular laboratory and piloting facilities management
Presentation, reporting and follow up proposals writing to national and European agencies
Publications, patent applications writing and follow up
Requirements:
PhD Degree in Separation/Analytical/Inorganic/Solution chemistry, metallurgy, process engineering, membrane based separations of metals, chemical engineering or a comparable degree program
Interest in solving complex metal separation and circular economy problems, experience in development and operating hydrometallurgical and membranes (supported liquid and chemically modified) based methods for metals separations is advantageous
Strong technical and experimental understanding, especially related to pilot plants and large scale chemicals handling
Knowledge of metallurgical processes (e.g. mass flow phenomenon, chemical modification for desired selectivity, solvent extraction, electrolysis) in relation to the critical and technology metals is advantageous
Knowledge of designing and chemical modification of membranes and multivalent ligands with synthetic organic chemistry will be advantageous
Independent, responsible, multicultural and team-oriented working style as well as the ability to document results with FAIR principles and in a structured manner
English (ILR Level 4 – Full professional proficiency) required, German advantageous
What we offer:
A vibrant research community in an open, diverse and international work environment
Scientific excellence and extensive professional networking opportunities
A wide range of qualification opportunities and individual career counseling provided by the Postdoc Center HZDR-TUD
Salary and social benefits in accordance with the collective agreement for the public sector (TVöD-Bund) including 30 days of paid holiday leave, company pension scheme (VBL)
We support a good work-life balance with the possibility of part-time employment, mobile working and flexible working hours
Numerous company health management offerings
Employee discounts with well-known providers via the platform Corporate Benefits
An employer subsidy for the "Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket"
How to apply:
Kindly submit your completed application (including cover letter, CV, diplomas/transcripts, etc.) only via our Online-application-system: https://www.hzdr.de/db/Cms?pNid=490&pLang=en&pOid=70902

That is why we live a corporate culture in which your voice matters – in projects, in the team and in your daily work. We offer you great creative freedom and encourage personal responsibility – so that you can fully exploit your potential and we together can continue to realise large international projects with our proprietary environmental technologies also in the future. Together, we aspire to write the next 100 years of our history. That is what we stand for. Perhaps soon you will, too?
Sales Manager (m/f/d)
Location: Ratingen, Germany (Headquarters)
Your Tasks
Sales for the product portfolio “Thermal Waste Treatment” in Europe and the Middle East
Development of the market position to become the preferred technology provider
Responsibility for the acquisition of new customers and initiation of project cooperations
Development and maintenance of a project portfolio in the assigned market area
Implementation of market entry and expansion strategies in line with the corporate strategy
Customer and market analysis to develop regional market knowledge and identify local cooperation partners
Participation in conferences and trade fairs
Preparation of presentations to present offers to clients and for internal approval processes
Prequalification for participation in public and private tenders
Preparing and conducting client negotiations together with the bid management team
Your profile
Degree in engineering or industrial engineering preferably in the field of mechanical, process or energy engineering or comparable training
Proven track record in sales and business development with private and public sector clients (e.g. utilities, municipal utilities, special purpose associations)
Experience in sales as well as bid preparation for complex projects in plant construction or related industries, ideally in the field of thermal waste utilisation, waste management, sewage sludge utilisation or power generation
Excellent communication, networking and negotiation skills
Goal-oriented, structured, analytical way of working
High level of commitment and initiative
High social competence and confident appearance
Business fluent in German and English, ideally one other foreign language, e.g. French or Italian
Willingness to travel regularly
Our Technology
Doosan Lentjes offers proprietary environmental technologies for thermal waste and sewage sludge treatment and energy recovery. Our areas of expertise include the combustion of renewable fuels such as waste, sewage sludge and biomass, heat recovery systems and flue gas cleaning equipment. We deliver flexible solutions for long-term waste disposal security and climate-friendly steam and power generation.
Our Values & Benefits
Indispensable technologies
We are proud that our proprietary technologies make an indispensable contribution to the reliable disposal of waste and sewage sludge. Because thermal treatment is the solution of choice for treating residual waste and sewage sludge in a resource-saving way according to the principles of a circular economy. This gives our products a perspective for many decades and you a job with a future.
From engineering to construction
We supply partial and complete plants for the thermal treatment of waste and sewage sludge from a single source. With proprietary technologies for incineration, steam generation and flue gas cleaning, we offer solutions along the entire process chains. So, in your daily work you are always involved in the big picture and have the opportunity to experience the fascination of plant engineering!
Free space & personal responsibility
We believe that highly qualified people need room for manoeuvre and freedom to develop their full potential. That is why you enjoy freedom of choice and a high degree of personal responsibility with us. Because you are the experts in your field and know best how to bring your projects forward.
Internationality & variety – every day
We are proud to be part of a global group of companies. This gives us the security and strength we need to realise complex large-scale international projects. Every contract is unique and you will benefit from a varied working day where you can always learn something new. No day is like the other and our routine is called variety.
Private & professional life in balance
We aim to help you achieve a good work-life balance – something that is also of particular concern to our works council! You can therefore look forward to flexible working hours with flexitime and a culture of mobile working, where you can work from home 40% a week in consultation with your supervisor. 30 days of annual leave are a standard at our company; in addition, you can expect up to four bridging days off per year. Overtime can be compensated for example with free time.
Together at eye level
We aim to be successful together – regardless of title or position. It is important to us to discuss with each other at eye level and to support good ideas. Our managers see themselves not only as your superiors, but also as your colleagues. We are convinced that this approach promotes creativity and cohesion at all levels.
Lentjes Family
We always give new colleagues a warm welcome and offer support wherever necessary. But even beyond onboarding, we are proud to say that you will be working with people you can really rely on and trust. From time to time, we also like to leave the daily work routine behind us to celebrate with our colleagues over cool drinks and a delicious buffet.
Cultural diversity
We are convinced that diversity is always an enrichment and that diversity positively influences success. Therefore, our company is characterised by cultural diversity and we are proud of that! We have colleagues from many different countries on board and live internationality not only in our projects.
Bicycle leasing
We encourage our employees to be active and therefore offer the possibility of leasing a bicycle (JobRad), which can of course be used privately. And there is a wide choice: whether mountain bike, Dutch bike or e-bike – almost any bike can become a JobRad. But that is not all: you can also lease additional bicycles for up to three family members.
Additional services for special private events
We celebrate extraordinary days in your life with you: If you tie the knot, for example, you can look forward to two additional days off and a small allowance to start your life together. If you are already celebrating your silver wedding anniversary, we will congratulate you with one additional day off. Is your family growing? What a happy occasion to present you with a small gift and to give you two extra days off!
Modern and air-conditioned working environment
We believe that a well-equipped working environment is elementary. Therefore, you can expect bright and friendly offices with air conditioning and an ergonomically equipped workplace.
Feel-good lounges
We believe that where work is done on complex projects and technologies, there must also be room for creative refuelling and personal exchange. Our cosy lounges therefore invite you to chat with colleagues over a cup of hot tea or a glass of latte macchiato or to have lunch together.
Gastronomic offer in the headquarter
We are pleased to offer you daily breakfast and lunch, freshly prepared in our canteen at the Ratingen site. In addition to meat dishes, our canteen always offers a vegetarian main course and fresh regional salads as well as sweet dessert options. In summer, we also like to meet in our beautiful inner courtyard with fountain to spend our lunch break together in the sun.
Free parking spaces
We strive to make it easy for you to get to work in the morning without having to search for a parking space. Whether you use the car or the bicycle – you will find a variety of free parking options in the outdoor or in the underground car park.

In bereichsübergreifenden Teams über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg an der Entwicklung von Nachhaltigkeitsstrategien und deren Umsetzung in bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse arbeiten? Das ist genau dein Ding?
Dann lebe deine Leidenschaft in einer Position, in der du Nachhaltigkeit fest im Geschäftsmodell unserer Kunden verankerst und eindrucksvoll aufzeigst, welche enormen Erfolgs- und Wachstumspotenziale in Themen wie Circular Economy, ESG, Ressourceneffizienz, Lieferkettenoptimierung, Human Rights, erneuerbare Energien und Low Carbon Technologies stecken.
Das erwartet dich
Du planst und begleitest unternehmensweite Veränderungsprogramme, optimierst Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmodelle.
In der Projektarbeit nutzt du dein Know-how in einem von drei Kernthemen: Circular Economy, Low Carbon Economy und Sustainable Valuation.
Circular Economy:
Wenn du schon Circular-Economy-Lösungen für Organisationen konzipiert und umgesetzt hast, unterstützt du Circular-Economy-Strategien, Maßnahmen für erhöhte Ressourceneffizienz oder die Optimierung und Neukonfiguration von Lieferketten und Geschäftsmodellen.
Low Carbon Economy:
Du hast dich bereits mit der Energiewende auseinandergesetzt? Dann beschäftigst du dich bei uns mit den geschäftlichen Auswirkungen eines der folgenden Themen: Einkauf/Nutzung erneuerbarer Energien, Ladeinfrastruktur, Speicherlösungen oder neue Geschäftsmodelle für die E-Mobilität sowie Low-Carbon-Produktinnovationen.
Sustainable Valuation:
Du verstehst die geschäftlichen Vorteile des nachhaltigen Wirtschaftens und weißt, dass neben den offensichtlichen Effizienzgewinnen signifikante Wachstums- und Differenzierungschancen bestehen? Dann nutze dein methodisches Wissen, um diese Chancen der Nachhaltigkeit in Zahlen darzustellen und unsere Klienten so bei der strategischen Entscheidungsfindung und in der Kommunikation mit Investoren zu unterstützen.
Darüber hinaus nutzt du dein Fachwissen und deine kreativen Ideen, um potenzielle Kunden von einer Zusammenarbeit mit uns zu überzeugen.

Partner with Industry BU Presidents to establish and implement strategic vision and market promotions based on grounded analysis.

Our Technology
Doosan Lentjes offers proprietary environmental technologies for thermal waste and sewage sludge treatment and energy recovery. Our areas of expertise include the combustion of renewable fuels such as waste, sewage sludge and biomass, heat recovery systems and flue gas cleaning equipment. We deliver flexible solutions for long-term waste disposal security and climate-friendly steam and power generation.
Our Values & Benefits
Indispensable technologies
We are proud that our proprietary technologies make an indispensable contribution to the reliable disposal of waste and sewage sludge. Because thermal treatment is the solution of choice for treating residual waste and sewage sludge in a resource-saving way according to the principles of a circular economy. This gives our products a perspective for many decades and you a job with a future.
From engineering to construction
We supply partial and complete plants for the thermal treatment of waste and sewage sludge from a single source. With proprietary technologies for incineration, steam generation and flue gas cleaning, we offer solutions along the entire process chains. So, in your daily work you are always involved in the big picture and have the opportunity to experience the fascination of plant engineering!
Free space & personal responsibility
We believe that highly qualified people need room for manoeuvre and freedom to develop their full potential. That is why you enjoy freedom of choice and a high degree of personal responsibility with us. Because you are the experts in your field and know best how to bring your projects forward.
Internationality & variety – every day
We are proud to be part of a global group of companies. This gives us the security and strength we need to realise complex large-scale international projects. Every contract is unique and you will benefit from a varied working day where you can always learn something new. No day is like the other and our routine is called variety.
Private & professional life in balance
We aim to help you achieve a good work-life balance – something that is also of particular concern to our works council! You can therefore look forward to flexible working hours with flexitime and a culture of mobile working, where you can work from home 40% a week in consultation with your supervisor. 30 days of annual leave are a standard at our company; in addition, you can expect up to four bridging days off per year. Overtime can be compensated for example with free time.
Together at eye level
We aim to be successful together – regardless of title or position. It is important to us to discuss with each other at eye level and to support good ideas. Our managers see themselves not only as your superiors, but also as your colleagues. We are convinced that this approach promotes creativity and cohesion at all levels.
Lentjes Family
We always give new colleagues a warm welcome and offer support wherever necessary. But even beyond onboarding, we are proud to say that you will be working with people you can really rely on and trust. From time to time, we also like to leave the daily work routine behind us to celebrate with our colleagues over cool drinks and a delicious buffet.
Cultural diversity
We are convinced that diversity is always an enrichment and that diversity positively influences success. Therefore, our company is characterised by cultural diversity and we are proud of that! We have colleagues from many different countries on board and live internationality not only in our projects.
Bicycle leasing
We encourage our employees to be active and therefore offer the possibility of leasing a bicycle (JobRad), which can of course be used privately. And there is a wide choice: whether mountain bike, Dutch bike or e-bike – almost any bike can become a JobRad. But that is not all: you can also lease additional bicycles for up to three family members.
Additional services for special private events
We celebrate extraordinary days in your life with you: If you tie the knot, for example, you can look forward to two additional days off and a small allowance to start your life together. If you are already celebrating your silver wedding anniversary, we will congratulate you with one additional day off. Is your family growing? What a happy occasion to present you with a small gift and to give you two extra days off!
Modern and air-conditioned working environment
We believe that a well-equipped working environment is elementary. Therefore, you can expect bright and friendly offices with air conditioning and an ergonomically equipped workplace.
Feel-good lounges
We believe that where work is done on complex projects and technologies, there must also be room for creative refuelling and personal exchange. Our cosy lounges therefore invite you to chat with colleagues over a cup of hot tea or a glass of latte macchiato or to have lunch together.
Gastronomic offer in the headquarter
We are pleased to offer you daily breakfast and lunch, freshly prepared in our canteen at the Ratingen site. In addition to meat dishes, our canteen always offers a vegetarian main course and fresh regional salads as well as sweet dessert options. In summer, we also like to meet in our beautiful inner courtyard with fountain to spend our lunch break together in the sun.
Free parking spaces
We strive to make it easy for you to get to work in the morning without having to search for a parking space. Whether you use the car or the bicycle – you will find a variety of free parking options in the outdoor or in the underground car park.

We at Doosan Lentjes are convinced: Only those who can fully develop their talent can achieve great things. That is why we live a corporate culture in which your voice matters – in projects, in the team and in your daily work. We offer you great creative freedom and encourage personal responsibility – so that you can fully exploit your potential and we together can continue to realise large international projects with our proprietary environmental technologies also in the future. Together, we aspire to write the next 100 years of our history. That is what we stand for. Perhaps soon you will, too?
Commissioning Planner (m/f/d)
Location: Ratingen, Germany (Headquarters)
Your Tasks
Ensuring that the commissioning planning and supervision of the commissioning personnel on site is carried out in accordance with quality standards, deadlines and budgets
Creation of commissioning concepts and commissioning schedules
Preparation of requests for external commissioning staff and commissioning costing
Organize and supervise commissioning staff from subcontractors
Commissioning progress tracking and reporting
Interface with customers, partners and consultants
Your Profile
Completed engineering studies (university / technical college) or technician with focus on mechanical engineering / process engineering or comparable training
At least 5 years of professional experience in plant commissioning, preferably in plant construction
Management experience in projects or sub-projects
Good German and English language skills
Above-average willingness to perform
Intercultural competence
Good communication skills
Systematic and structured way of working
Our Technology
Doosan Lentjes offers proprietary environmental technologies for thermal waste and sewage sludge treatment and energy recovery. Our areas of expertise include the combustion of renewable fuels such as waste, sewage sludge and biomass, heat recovery systems and flue gas cleaning equipment. We deliver flexible solutions for long-term waste disposal security and climate-friendly steam and power generation.
Our Values & Benefits
Indispensable technologies
We are proud that our proprietary technologies make an indispensable contribution to the reliable disposal of waste and sewage sludge. Because thermal treatment is the solution of choice for treating residual waste and sewage sludge in a resource-saving way according to the principles of a circular economy. This gives our products a perspective for many decades and you a job with a future.
From engineering to construction
We supply partial and complete plants for the thermal treatment of waste and sewage sludge from a single source. With proprietary technologies for incineration, steam generation and flue gas cleaning, we offer solutions along the entire process chains. So, in your daily work you are always involved in the big picture and have the opportunity to experience the fascination of plant engineering!
Free space & personal responsibility
We believe that highly qualified people need room for manoeuvre and freedom to develop their full potential. That is why you enjoy freedom of choice and a high degree of personal responsibility with us. Because you are the experts in your field and know best how to bring your projects forward.
Internationality & variety – every day
We are proud to be part of a global group of companies. This gives us the security and strength we need to realise complex large-scale international projects. Every contract is unique and you will benefit from a varied working day where you can always learn something new. No day is like the other and our routine is called variety.
Private & professional life in balance
We aim to help you achieve a good work-life balance – something that is also of particular concern to our works council! You can therefore look forward to flexible working hours with flexitime and a culture of mobile working, where you can work from home 40% a week in consultation with your supervisor. 30 days of annual leave are a standard at our company; in addition, you can expect up to four bridging days off per year. Overtime can be compensated for example with free time.
Together at eye level
We aim to be successful together – regardless of title or position. It is important to us to discuss with each other at eye level and to support good ideas. Our managers see themselves not only as your superiors, but also as your colleagues. We are convinced that this approach promotes creativity and cohesion at all levels.
Lentjes Family
We always give new colleagues a warm welcome and offer support wherever necessary. But even beyond onboarding, we are proud to say that you will be working with people you can really rely on and trust. From time to time, we also like to leave the daily work routine behind us to celebrate with our colleagues over cool drinks and a delicious buffet.
Cultural diversity
We are convinced that diversity is always an enrichment and that diversity positively influences success. Therefore, our company is characterised by cultural diversity and we are proud of that! We have colleagues from many different countries on board and live internationality not only in our projects.
Bicycle leasing
We encourage our employees to be active and therefore offer the possibility of leasing a bicycle (JobRad), which can of course be used privately. And there is a wide choice: whether mountain bike, Dutch bike or e-bike – almost any bike can become a JobRad. But that is not all: you can also lease additional bicycles for up to three family members.
Additional services for special private events
We celebrate extraordinary days in your life with you: If you tie the knot, for example, you can look forward to two additional days off and a small allowance to start your life together. If you are already celebrating your silver wedding anniversary, we will congratulate you with one additional day off. Is your family growing? What a happy occasion to present you with a small gift and to give you two extra days off!
Modern and air-conditioned working environment
We believe that a well-equipped working environment is elementary. Therefore, you can expect bright and friendly offices with air conditioning and an ergonomically equipped workplace.
Feel-good lounges
We believe that where work is done on complex projects and technologies, there must also be room for creative refuelling and personal exchange. Our cosy lounges therefore invite you to chat with colleagues over a cup of hot tea or a glass of latte macchiato or to have lunch together.
Gastronomic offer in the headquarter
We are pleased to offer you daily breakfast and lunch, freshly prepared in our canteen at the Ratingen site. In addition to meat dishes, our canteen always offers a vegetarian main course and fresh regional salads as well as sweet dessert options. In summer, we also like to meet in our beautiful inner courtyard with fountain to spend our lunch break together in the sun.
Free parking spaces
We strive to make it easy for you to get to work in the morning without having to search for a parking space. Whether you use the car or the bicycle – you will find a variety of free parking options in the outdoor or in the underground car park.

At the center of our actions lies the responsibility for the environment. As the forerunner on the path to carbon neutrality and circular economy in the building materials industry, we are working on sustainable building materials and solutions for the future. We enable new opportunities for our customers through digitalization.
For our Group Shared Service Center Department we are seeking to recruit a Project Manager Budget-To-Report (f/m/d).
As a B2R Project Manager, you will be responsible for the identification of gaps between existing processes and the global business processes defined by the Global Process Owner (GPO) as well as for launching and monitoring of process improvement initiatives.
In this role you will support the GSSC GPOs during the SAP S/4HANA project, to ensure that the entire GSSC business processes are fully converted into SAP S/4HANA. You will also support to develop process-based solution proposals with the target to achieve the highest possible added value from the SAP S/4HANA conversion and thus a high level of end user satisfaction within the SSC community and other business departments involved.
You will report to the Director Group Shared Service Center and you will be located in Heidelberg.

Close collaboration with the Global Process Owners
Proactive cooperation with the entire Group SSC Team to share information, get guidance and document results
Develop and maintain business policies which drive our processes
Ensure compliance, standardization and harmonized processes across business lines
Understand business user needs and processes to suggest efficient end-to-end enhancements in close alignment with the GPO, Group Departments and Digital
Improve existing processes wherever possible with SAP S/4HANA to reach highly efficient performance indicators
Launching projects to identify best practices and to transfer the best-in-class solutions to the SSCs
Communicate and facilitate discussions with all involved parties, prepare and hold presentations to drive solutions on proposed features and functionalities
Work with IT teams to ensure good fit to existing Infrastructure technologies and applications (where applicable), to obtain project budgets
Ensure the delivery of high-quality transaction processes
Willingness to travel to business offices as appropriate and as necessary
Deliver process related trainings
Rollout / support of process related software tools

University degree
SAP Junior experts in the areas of accounting and controlling

3 years’ consulting experience in business process improvement initiatives, accounting, controlling, consolidation and/or shared service center processes

Strong analytical and technical skills

Goal orientation

We are Covestro. We are curious. We are courageous. We are colorful. We refine chemical material solutions with game-changing products. Let us empower you to push boundaries. Join us and our 18.150 colleagues now and together we will make the world a brighter place.
WHAT WE OFFER
Our Controlling team collaborates with a broad range of departments and functions at Covestro to generate relevant business insights. Our work enables the Covestro management to fully understand relevant information, take the right decisions and implement action plans through tailored business partnering. We constantly develop and refine our tools and processes to reflect state-of-the-art standards in data analytics, reporting, forecasting, planning and business steering, which include statistical, machine learning and BI applications. Furthermore our Controlling department plays an essential role in one of our currently most important projects – making Covestro fully circular in the future. During your internship you will work in Performance Materials Controlling, a department in the CFO area that supports Covestro's largest business entity.
Your tasks and responsibilities:
Support financial planning and forecasting processes, as well as subsequently track and analyse forecast deviations in order to help the management to efficiently run the operative business
Help to prepare strategy conferences and take part in strategic projects which help Covestro to achieve its sustainability goals
Perform detailed profitability analyses for different product groups and regions with the help of statistical models
Review and analyze marketing, sales and manufacturing costs in order to help Covestro meet its cost targets
Preparing presentations and reports for Covestro's high level management team
Contribute and support in ad hoc analysis of relevant business data and project related tasks, e.g. circular economy and energy-efficiency projects
Conceptual work, including the optimization of existing tools, applications and processes
WHAT YOU OFFER
You are a Bachelor or Master student (m/f/d) in Controlling, Accounting, Finance or a comparable course of study
Ideally, you have already gained some practical experience in Controlling, Accounting or Finance
You have good user skills in MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint), high command of digitalization and automation skills desirable (e.g. R, Python, VBA)
You have an analytical mindset and enjoy communicating concepts and ideas with stakeholders on a global level
You are able to multi-task and achieve a high quality standard at the same time
Excellent English skills are required, German is desirable
Please note, the duration of the internship is 4 to preferably 6 months. After the first training sessions in Leverkusen office, mobile working within Germany will be definitely possible.
Please also let us know your possible starting date as well as the duration and apply with your complete documents (cover letter, CV, certificates, enrollment certificate, examination/study regulations).
If you have any questions regarding the application process, please do not hesitate to contact our Recruiting Team (recruiting@covestro.com).
YOUR APPLICATION
Are you curious, courageous and colorful as we are? If so, we can offer you exciting career opportunities. We look forward to receiving your application including a cover letter, your resume, certificates as well as your salary expectations and your notice period. Become part of our Team - apply now!
Anyone who wants to contribute to a better world with Covestro can also expect a lot.
We want you to feel at home at Covestro. To feel you’re treated fairly and transparently. That means financial security, a healthy work-life balance and generous benefits.
Specifically, it means for us: flexible working hours, the compatibility of family and work, active health promotion and the ability to convert part of your salary into long-term or retirement savings. And that's not all.

Lead Engineer Civil (m/f/d)

Management of architectural and engineering offices, specialist planners and experts in concept, design, approval and implementation planning and the preparation of documentation

Our Technology
Doosan Lentjes offers proprietary environmental technologies for thermal waste and sewage sludge treatment and energy recovery. Our areas of expertise include the combustion of renewable fuels such as waste, sewage sludge and biomass, heat recovery systems and flue gas cleaning equipment. We deliver flexible solutions for long-term waste disposal security and climate-friendly steam and power generation.
Our Values & Benefits
Indispensable technologies
We are proud that our proprietary technologies make an indispensable contribution to the reliable disposal of waste and sewage sludge. Because thermal treatment is the solution of choice for treating residual waste and sewage sludge in a resource-saving way according to the principles of a circular economy. This gives our products a perspective for many decades and you a job with a future.
From engineering to construction
We supply partial and complete plants for the thermal treatment of waste and sewage sludge from a single source. With proprietary technologies for incineration, steam generation and flue gas cleaning, we offer solutions along the entire process chains. So, in your daily work you are always involved in the big picture and have the opportunity to experience the fascination of plant engineering!
Free space & personal responsibility
We believe that highly qualified people need room for manoeuvre and freedom to develop their full potential. That is why you enjoy freedom of choice and a high degree of personal responsibility with us. Because you are the experts in your field and know best how to bring your projects forward.
Internationality & variety – every day
We are proud to be part of a global group of companies. This gives us the security and strength we need to realise complex large-scale international projects. Every contract is unique and you will benefit from a varied working day where you can always learn something new. No day is like the other and our routine is called variety.
Private & professional life in balance
We aim to help you achieve a good work-life balance – something that is also of particular concern to our works council! You can therefore look forward to flexible working hours with flexitime and a culture of mobile working, where you can work from home 40% a week in consultation with your supervisor. 30 days of annual leave are a standard at our company; in addition, you can expect up to four bridging days off per year. Overtime can be compensated for example with free time.
Together at eye level
We aim to be successful together – regardless of title or position. It is important to us to discuss with each other at eye level and to support good ideas. Our managers see themselves not only as your superiors, but also as your colleagues. We are convinced that this approach promotes creativity and cohesion at all levels.
Lentjes Family
We always give new colleagues a warm welcome and offer support wherever necessary. But even beyond onboarding, we are proud to say that you will be working with people you can really rely on and trust. From time to time, we also like to leave the daily work routine behind us to celebrate with our colleagues over cool drinks and a delicious buffet.
Cultural diversity
We are convinced that diversity is always an enrichment and that diversity positively influences success. Therefore, our company is characterised by cultural diversity and we are proud of that! We have colleagues from many different countries on board and live internationality not only in our projects.
Bicycle leasing
We encourage our employees to be active and therefore offer the possibility of leasing a bicycle (JobRad), which can of course be used privately. And there is a wide choice: whether mountain bike, Dutch bike or e-bike – almost any bike can become a JobRad. But that is not all: you can also lease additional bicycles for up to three family members.
Additional services for special private events
We celebrate extraordinary days in your life with you: If you tie the knot, for example, you can look forward to two additional days off and a small allowance to start your life together. If you are already celebrating your silver wedding anniversary, we will congratulate you with one additional day off. Is your family growing? What a happy occasion to present you with a small gift and to give you two extra days off!
Modern and air-conditioned working environment
We believe that a well-equipped working environment is elementary. Therefore, you can expect bright and friendly offices with air conditioning and an ergonomically equipped workplace.
Feel-good lounges
We believe that where work is done on complex projects and technologies, there must also be room for creative refuelling and personal exchange. Our cosy lounges therefore invite you to chat with colleagues over a cup of hot tea or a glass of latte macchiato or to have lunch together.
Gastronomic offer in the headquarter
We are pleased to offer you daily breakfast and lunch, freshly prepared in our canteen at the Ratingen site. In addition to meat dishes, our canteen always offers a vegetarian main course and fresh regional salads as well as sweet dessert options. In summer, we also like to meet in our beautiful inner courtyard with fountain to spend our lunch break together in the sun.
Free parking spaces
We strive to make it easy for you to get to work in the morning without having to search for a parking space. Whether you use the car or the bicycle – you will find a variety of free parking options in the outdoor or in the underground car park.

The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft (www.fraunhofer.com) currently operates 76 institutes and research institutions throughout Germany and is the world’s leading applied research organization. Around 30 000 employees work with an annual research budget of 2.9 billion euros.

Pushing boundaries. Always trying something new. Not just thinking, but thinking ahead. We turn research into the future.
We want an earth that is worth living on. With our applied research on Circular Economy, Carbon Management, Green Hydrogen and Local Energy Systems, we make concrete contributions to achieving the United Nations' 17 Sustainable Development Goals. Our employees conduct research in the areas of energy, environment, safety, health, communication and mobility.
The department Chemical Energy Storage is conducting the Carbon2Chem project. For the catalytic oxygen removal in the subproject L3 gas purification we are looking for you to support our team in the area of catalyst testing and process optimization.

Maintenance of the testing facility
Testing of sulfidic catalysts
Optimization of catalytic processes
Evaluation of experimental results via Python
Evaluation of characterization results (XRD, XPS, ICP-OES, TPR, TPO, TPS)

Ongoing studies in the field of technical chemistry, process engineering, chemical engineering or similar
Advanced knowledge in heterogeneous catalysis
Profound knowledge in Python programming is an advantage
Independent and systematic way of working
Willingness to learn new topics

As part of a dynamic team, you actively drive sustainable solutions for a resource-efficient future
Opportunity to combine your knowledge from your studies with practical experience at the interface between business and science and to integrate your own ideas
New Work, diversity and cooperative interaction are important components of our strategic orientation
Flexible working hours - we know that your studies come first
Flexible work locations that fit your studies - mobile work and on-site work are combined as needed
Intense support for the preparation of your final thesis
Health and mindfulness programs for good balance
You can find even more attractive benefits here: Fraunhofer UMSICHT as employer
The weekly working time is 39 hours. This position is limited to 6 months. job_title_name: Doktorand*in im Themenbereich Environmental Co-Design of Molecules
job_description:
Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft betreibt in Deutschland derzeit 76 Institute und Forschungseinrichtungen und ist die weltweit führende Organisation für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. Rund 30 000 Mitarbeitende erarbeiten das jährliche Forschungsvolumen von 2,9 Milliarden Euro.
Die Gruppe Additiv-Chemie synthetisiert und bewertet Kunststoffadditive, insbesondere Flammschutzmittel, Geruchsschutzmittel, Kunststoffkreislaufadditive und Compounds für Elektrochemie & Elektrolyse.
Im engen Austausch mit den Forschungsgruppen am Fraunhofer ICT unterstützt die Gruppe Additiv-Chemie Forschungs- und Industriepartner bei der Erforschung und Entwicklung von Materialien, Prozessen, Produkten, Prüfmethoden und Simulationen.
Gemeinsam mit der Fraunhofer ICT-Gruppe Sustainability and Circularity Assessment (SuCA) beziehen wir die Ökobilanzierung und ecoDESIGN-Konzepte in alle unsere Additiventwicklungen mit ein.
Weitere Informationen:
Additiv-Chemie (AddChem) - Fraunhofer ICT
Nachhaltigkeits- und Kreislaufbewertung (SuCA – Sustainability and Circularity Assessment) - Fraunhofer ICT
Was Sie bei uns tun
Eine vorteilhafte Umweltverträglichkeit von Produkten wird immer bedeutender. Wir möchten die Umweltauswirkung als Optimierungsparameter, neben Materialperformanz und Kosten, daher bereits so zeitig wie möglich anwenden – idealerweise bereits beim Moleküldesign.
Ziele Ihrer projektbegleitenden Promotion sind:
Erarbeitung einer Methode zur Bewertung von Umweltauswirkungen (Emission/Toxizität/Verweilzeit) in der Molekül- und Materialkonzeptionierungsphase
Industrialisierung von Life-Cycle-Inventory (LCI)-Labordaten
Entwicklung von Methoden zur Messung von LCI-Daten für Labor- und Technikumsversuche
Konzeptionierung und Durchführung von Laborversuchen zur Erzeugung von LCI-Daten
ggf. Erforschung der Eignung von Sensoren- und Messsystemen zur Erfassung relevanter Energie- und Stoffströme (z.B. auch in die Gasphase)
Modellierung (z.B. mit Aspen Plus) von industriellen Prozessen anhand von Labordaten: Überführung von LCI-Labormesswerten in industrielle LCI
Aufbau einer umfangreichen Datenbank an LCI und Ökobilanz-Modellen (in Kooperation mit Fraunhofer ICT-LCA-Experten) für verschiedene Molekülklassen und Materialklassen, mit starkem Fokus auf den relevanten Molekülklassen und Additiventwicklungen der Fraunhofer ICT-Gruppe Additiv-Chemie
Environmental Co-Design: Entwicklungsbegleitende Analyse und Bewertung von Synthese und Materialentwicklungsaktivitäten der Fraunhofer ICT-Gruppe Additiv-Chemie. Ziel: die Umweltauswirkung als Entscheidungs- und Optimierungsparameter bereits beim Moleküldesign einsetzen.
Ihr Forschungs- und Promotionsschwerpunkt wird gemeinsam mit Ihnen im Laufe des ersten Jahres erarbeitet und definiert.
Als wissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in obliegt Ihnen neben den Forschungsaufgaben und deren internationalen Veröffentlichung auch der Ausbau des Forschungsfelds durch die Akquisition neuer Auftraggeber aus der Industrie sowie von Forschungsprojekten der öffentlichen Hand.
Was Sie mitbringen
Sie verfügen über einen Abschluss eines wissenschaftlichen Hochschulstudiums (Master/Diplom univ.) der Fachrichtungen Chemie, chemische Verfahrenstechnik, Materialwissenschaften oder vergleichbarer Disziplinen.
Idealerweise haben Sie erste Erfahrungen und Interesse in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Themenbereiche:
Physikalische und Analytische Chemie
Toxikologie und Chemikalienbewertung/ -Gesetzgebung (u.a. ECHA, REACh)
Technische Chemie und Prozesssimulation
Life-Cycle-Assessment / Ökobilanzierung
Sie haben Spaß daran, sich in neue Technologien hineinzudenken und aktiv in den Austausch mit nationalen und internationalen Technologie-Expert*innen zu treten?
Das Tätigsein im Team und Freude im Umgang mit Kolleg*innen und Kund*innen sind für Sie selbstverständlich und runden Ihr Profil ab?
Ihre Arbeit ist geprägt durch ein hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit und Flexibilität?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!
Was Sie erwarten können
Sie sind Mitglied in einem motivierten, lernbegeisterten, interdisziplinären und kollegialen Team am Fraunhofer ICT und arbeiten in einem innovativen und zukunftsträchtigen Forschungsbereich.
Sie arbeiten im Clean Aviation Programm - das führende Forschungs- und Innovationsprogramm der Europäischen Union zur Umgestaltung der Luftfahrt in Richtung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft. Sie arbeiten insbesondere in den Clean Aviation Projekten SMR-ACAP und FASTER-H2.
Clean Aviation - SMR-ACAP - Fraunhofer ICT
Clean Aviation - FASTER-H2 - Fraunhofer ICT

job_title_name: Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) mit Promotionsziel im Bereich Nachhaltige Materialflüsse für Lithium-Ionen- und Post-Lithium-Batterien
job_description:
Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) mit Promotionsziel im Bereich Nachhaltige Materialflüsse für Lithium-Ionen- und Post-Lithium-Batterien
Lehrstuhl für Ökologische Ressourcentechnologie
Bewerbungsfrist: 30. Dezember 2023
Die Universität Bayreuth ist eine forschungsorientierte Universität mit international kompetitiven und interdisziplinär ausgerichteten Profilfeldern in Forschung und Lehre.
Am Lehrstuhl für Ökologische Ressourcentechnologie der Fakultät für Ingenieurwissenschaften ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine befristete Stelle in Vollzeit (40,10 Std.) mit Vergütung nach Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L als
Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) mit Promotionsziel im Bereich Nachhaltige Materialflüsse für Lithium-Ionen- und Post-Lithium-Batterien
zu besetzen.
Der Lehrstuhl für Ökologische Ressourcentechnologie setzt seine Schwerpunkte in der Modellierung, Simulation und Bewertung umweltverträglicher und nachhaltiger Technologien für die Rückgewinnung wertstoffreicher Sekundärrohstoffe. In der Forschung beschäftigen wir uns mit der Nutzung und Verarbeitung von Ressourcen in globalen Kreisläufen vom Bergbau und der Rohstoffgewinnung über die Fertigungs- und Produktnutzungsphase bis hin zum Recycling. Wir verwenden Methoden der Industrial Ecology, insbesondere Ökobilanzierung, Materialflussanalyse und Rohstoffkritikalitätsbewertung. Hierbei werden ökologische und techno-ökonomische Fragen betrachtet. Das junge Lehrstuhlteam legt viel Wert auf interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit und bietet Ihnen vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur aktiven Mitgestaltung.
Das Promotionsthema ist eingebettet in das Graduiertenkolleg des Bayerischen Zentrums für Batterietechnik (BayBatt). Das BayBatt bündelt fakultätsübergreifend die batteriespezifische Expertise in Physik und Chemie, Material- und Ingenieurwissenschaften sowie Informatik und Ökonomie. Batterien spielen eine herausragende Rolle in den Sektoren Elektromobilität, Stationäre Speicher für Zuhause und im Stromnetz, Elektronische Geräte und Werkzeuge. In dem Forschungsthema sollen in Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitsgruppen in den Ingenieurwissenschaften und der Chemie die zukünftigen Rohstoffnachfragen und Kreislaufwirtschaftspotentiale für Lithium-Ionen-Batterien und in Entwicklung befindlichen weiteren Batterietechnologien ermittelt und bewertet werden.
Ihr Aufgabengebiet:
Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung von Materialflussanalysen mit Schwerpunkt auf Batterien und Batterierohstoffen
Modellierung, Simulation und Bewertung der Rohstoffnachfrage unter Berücksichtigung von angepassten Technologieszenarien für zukünftige Batterietechnologien und -anwendungen
Weiterentwicklung der Bewertung der Kreislaufwirtschaftspotentiale in dynamischen Materialflussanalysen
Weitergehende Bewertung der Ergebnisse aus der Materialflussanalyse mit Methoden der Ökobilanzierung (Life Cycle Assessment) und der Rohstoffkritikalitätsbewertung
Eigenständige Forschungsarbeit an Ihrem konkreten Promotionsprojekt
Aktive Mitarbeit im Graduiertenkolleg des Bayerischen Zentrums für Batterietechnik (BayBatt)
Publikation wissenschaftlicher Artikel und Präsentation der Ergebnisse auf Konferenzen in deutscher und englischer Sprache
Eigenverantwortliche Mitarbeit in Forschungsprojekten und Industrieprojekten
Mitwirkung in der Lehre in Form von Lehrveranstaltungen und der Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten
Ihr Profil:
sehr gut oder gut abgeschlossenes ingenieur- oder naturwissenschaftliches Masterstudium
idealerweise Vertiefungsrichtung mit Bezug auf Circular Economy, Recycling, Ressourceneffizienz, Rohstoffe oder vergleichbarem Nachhaltigkeitsbezug
idealerweise Erfahrung mit Batterietechnik, Batteriematerialien oder vergleichbaren Technologien
idealerweise Programmiererfahrung mit python oder einer vergleichbaren Programmiersprache
selbständige Arbeitsweise, wissenschaftliche Gründlichkeit, systematisch-analytisches Denken, Engagement, Kreativität und Teamfähigkeit
Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und wissenschaftlichem Austausch
Was Sie erwarten können:
Wir unterstützen Sie dabei, durch Ihre selbständige ingenieurwissenschaftliche Tätigkeit zum Dr.-Ing. zu promovieren
Ihr Promotionsvorhaben ist eingebunden in das strukturierte Promotionsprogramm des Bayerischen Zentrums für Batterietechnik (BayBatt)
Wir fördern Ihre wissenschaftliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung

job_title_name: BA/MA: »Technologien zur Umsetzung der Circular Economy«
job_description:
Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft betreibt in Deutschland derzeit 76 Institute und Forschungseinrichtungen und ist die weltweit führende Organisation für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. Rund 30 000 Mitarbeitende erarbeiten das jährliche Forschungsvolumen von 2,9 Milliarden Euro.
Am Fraunhofer IPT in Aachen arbeiten wir mit mehr als 480 Mitarbeiter*innen täglich daran, dass die Produktion der Zukunft digitaler, flexibler und nachhaltiger wird. In der Abteilung Technologiemanagement beraten und begleiten wir Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu einem nachhaltigen Wachstum: von der Konzeption bis hin zur inhaltlichen Ausgestaltung ihrer Strategien, Prozesse und Methoden.
Nachhaltiges Handeln ist ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor produzierender Unternehmen, um deren Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu sichern. Damit die Transformation hin zu einer Kreislaufwirtschaft (engl. Circular Economy), also die bestmögliche Ausschöpfung materieller Ressource, auch mit ökonomischen Mehrwerten gelingt, ist die Nutzungsphase von Produkten durch die Realisierung von Re-X-Ansätzen zu maximieren. Folglich müssen zukünftige Produkt- sowie zugehörige Technologiegenerationen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus vorgedacht und designt werden. Jedoch fehlt es produzierenden Unternehmen derzeit an einem ganzheitlichen Ansatz für die langfristige Bewertung von Technologien unter Berücksichtigung von ökonomischen sowie ökologischen Gesichtspunkten als Grundlage zur Auswahl und Planung der Produkttechnologien. Daher ist es wichtig, ein Verständnis darüber zu schaffen, welche methodischen Ansätze zur Lösung dieser Herausforderung aktuell existieren und wo deren Potenziale und Limitationen liegen.
Was Du bei uns tust
Definition relevanter Begrifflichkeiten der Circular Economy
Umfangreiche Literaturrecherche zum Stand der Technik in Bezug auf bestehende Ansätze zur Bewertung und Planung von Technologien für die Kreislaufwirtschaft
Analyse und Bewertung der identifizierten Ansätze und Ableitung eines Forschungsbedarfs
Was Du mitbringst
Du studierst (Wirtschafts-) Ingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Umweltingenieurwesen oder ein vergleichbares Fach und kannst gute Studienleistungen vorweisen
Du interessierst dich für die Kreislaufwirtschaft und deren strategischen Implikationen für die Industrie
Du bist in der Lage, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu abstrahieren und strukturiert darzustellen
Du bist hoch motiviert und arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich
Du verfügst über sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was Du erwarten kannst

Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.
Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. job_description:
Stellenanzeige merkenStellenanzeige teilen
Ein besseres Leben für alle und sinnstiftende Aufgaben für unsere Mitarbeiter*innen – das ist unser Erfolgsmodell. Seit mehr als 50 Jahren unterstützt die Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) als Unternehmen der Bundesregierung bei der weltweiten Umsetzung entwicklungspolitischer Ziele. Gemeinsam mit Partnerorganisationen in 120 Ländern engagieren wir uns in unterschiedlichsten Projekten. Wenn Sie etwas in der Welt bewegen und sich selbst dabei entwickeln möchten, sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Tätigkeitsbereich
Neben der deutschen Bundesregierung können internationale Institutionen, Regierungen, Stiftungen und weltweit agierende Unternehmen die GIZ beauftragen. Wir bieten unseren Kund*innen hochkompetente und leistungsfähige Teams aus deutschen, internationalen und lokalen Fachleuten in mehr als 120 Ländern. Dank dieses breitgefächerten, jeweils individuell auf die Kund*innen zugeschnittenen Know-hows, sind wir in der Lage, auch hochkomplexe Herausforderungen zu meistern.
Unser Team Private Sector Clients arbeitet an der dynamischen Schnittstelle zwischen Privatwirtschaft und internationaler Zusammenarbeit. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, die UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) weltweit umzusetzen, vornehmlich in Afrika, Asien und Lateinamerika. Dabei skalieren wir erfolgreiche Lösungsansätze der internationalen Zusammenarbeit oder testen in uns bekannten lokalen Kontexten innovative Ansätze. Wir bieten Unternehmen individuelle Beratung, von der Idee über die Konzeption und das Projektmanagement bis hin zum Nachweis messbarer Ergebnisse und Wirkungen. Unser Portfolio beinhaltet Projekte und Kund*innen im Agrar-, Textil-, Forst-, Bildungs- und Gesundheitssektor sowie Abfallmanagement mit wachsendem Schwerpunkt auf Circular Economy Ansätze. Bei unseren Projekten arbeiten wir hauptsächlich an der Gestaltung nachhaltiger Lieferketten sowie der Umsetzung von CSR-Maßnahmen und zu Maßnahmen um den Klimawandel zu mitigieren.
Ihre Aufgaben
Als Praktikant*in komplementieren Sie unser Team u.a. durch folgende Aktivitäten:
Sie unterstützen laufende Projekte in der Umsetzung, u.a. beim Reporting, der Absprache und Koordination mit Expert*innen sowie den Fachabteilungen innerhalb der GIZ und können somit einen umfassenden Einblick in das Projektmanagement gewinnen
Sie bereiten Arbeitsergebnisse, Berichte und Kommunikationsmaterialien für unsere Auftraggeber in PowerPoint Präsentationen auf
Sie unterstützen laufende Akquisitionen neuer Projekte durch Recherche und die Identifikation relevanter Expert*innen innerhalb der GIZ
Sie wirken bei der Entwicklung von Projektkonzepten mit und stellen diese eigenverantwortlich in PowerPoint Präsentationen dar
Sie nehmen an Kundenterminen (z.B. Telefonkonferenzen, Workshops) teil und bereiten diese vor sowie nach
Sie recherchieren zu aktuellen Entwicklungs- und Supply-Chain-Themen
Sie bewerten die Bedeutung dieser Rechercheergebnisse für den Privatsektor und identifizieren anhand dessen gemeinsam mit den Projektmanager*innen mögliche Projektansätze und Leistungsangebote für die Privatwirtschaft
Durch die Recherche von Leistungsangeboten und Expertisen innerhalb der GIZ verbessern Sie das Wissensmanagement des Teams
Ihr Profil
Sie studieren ab dem vierten Semester, vorzugsweise Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschafts-, Politik-, Sozial-, oder Nachhaltigkeitswissenschaften
Sie haben Interesse an der Verbindung von Unternehmen und Nachhaltigkeit/EZ und können dies beispielsweise durch entsprechende Studienschwerpunkte oder relevante Praktika belegen
Sie verfügen über Sensibilität zur Kooperation in unterschiedlichen kulturellen Kontexten, z.B. durch erste Praktika, Studium oder Auslandsaufenthalte
Sie sind zuverlässig, pragmatisch und kreativ und können sich gut in eine vielseitige Themenlandschaft einbringen
Sie sind belastbar und sind in der Lage, verschiedene Arbeitsaufträge mit knappen Deadlines zu priorisieren und zuverlässig zu erfüllen
Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind aber auch fähig, eigenständig zu arbeiten
Sehr gute Kenntnisse der gängigen Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere MS PowerPoint
Sie verfügen über fließende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch; Kenntnisse in Spanisch und/oder Französisch sind wünschenswert.
Hinweise
Die GIZ ist Unterzeichnerin der Charta der Vielfalt. Anerkennung, Wertschätzung und Einbeziehung von Vielfalt im Unternehmen sind uns wichtig. Alle Mitarbeiter*innen sollen Wertschätzung erfahren – unabhängig von Geschlecht und geschlechtlicher Identität, Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung.
Das Praktikum ist nur möglich, wenn Sie aktuell immatrikuliert sind, sich in einer Weiterbildung befinden, deren integraler Bestandteil die Absolvierung eines Praktikums ist oder der Studienabschluss zu Beginn des Praktikums nicht länger als 6 Monate zurückliegt.
Die monatliche Praktikantenvergütung beträgt €2.134,52 (brutto).
Die GIZ möchte den Anteil von Menschen mit Behinderung im Unternehmen erhöhen. Daher freuen wir uns über entsprechende Bewerbungen.

job_description:
Die Abteilung Nachhaltige Produktion arbeitet daran, die Nutzung erneuerbarer Energien in der Produktion zu ermöglichen, produzierende Unternehmen zu befähigen, nachhaltiger, sauberer und umweltverträglicher zu wirtschaften und ihre Wertschöpfungsketten so zu gestalten, dass sie so wenig Ressourcen wie möglich verbrauchen und diese im Sinne der Kreislaufwirtschaft bestenfalls nur nutzen. Deshalb suchen wir im Bereich Circular Economy für eine nachhaltige Produktion für unser Team ab sofort, in Vollzeit, einen wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeitenden (m/w/d).
Über uns
Das Institut für Werkzeugmaschinen und Betriebswissenschaften (iwb) der Technischen Universität München ist eines der großen produktionstechnischen Institute in Deutschland. Die Themenschwerpunkte umfassen die Bereiche Produktion und Logistik, Werkzeugmaschinen, Montagetechnik und Robotik, Batterieproduktion, Nachhaltige Produktion sowie Lasertechnik. In diesen Themenfeldern arbeiten die wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeitenden des iwb in Forschung, Lehre und Industrietransfer mit dem Ziel der Promotion. Die Abteilung Nachhaltige Produktion arbeitet daran, die Nutzung erneuerbarer Energien in der Produktion zu ermöglichen, produzierende Unternehmen zu befähigen, nachhaltiger, sauberer und umweltverträglicher zu wirtschaften und ihre Wertschöpfungsketten so zu gestalten, dass sie so wenig Ressourcen wie möglich verbrauchen und diese im Sinne der Kreislaufwirtschaft bestenfalls nur nutzen.

Organisationseinheit
Institut für Industriebetriebslehre und Industrielle Produktion (IIP)
Ihre Aufgaben
Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört die Bearbeitung interdisziplinärer, praxisorientierter Forschungsprojekte, die sich mit der techno-ökonomischen und ökologischen Analyse und Modellierung aktueller Entwicklungen in der Produktions- und Kreislaufwirtschaft beschäftigen. Die Möglichkeit zur Promotion ist gegeben.
Die Stelle ist am Lehrstuhl für Betriebswirtschaftslehre insbesondere Produktionswirtschaft und Logistik (Prof. Dr. F. Schultmann) in der Arbeitsgruppe „Projekt- und Ressourcenmanagement in der bebauten Umwelt“ von PD Dr. Rebekka Volk angesiedelt. Die Schwerpunkte sind techno-ökonomische und ökologische Analysen sowie systemische Analysen neuer industrieller Prozesse und Technologien. Dies umfasst beispielsweise die Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung der Methoden der Ökobilanz, des Life Cycle Costings, des Material-Flow-Cost-Accountings sowie von optimierenden Standort- und Kapazitätsplanungen im Bereich des Ressourcenmanagements, der Circular Economy und insbesondere des Recyclings. Des Weiteren sollen innovative quantitative und optimierende Ansätze, sowie Ansätze zur Untersuchung der Akzeptanz, zum Management, zur Entwicklung von Geschäftsmodellen und zur Entscheidungsunterstützung zur nachhaltigen Entwicklung von Wertschöpfungsketten konzipiert, entwickelt und angewendet werden.

job_title_name: Scientist in heterogeneous catalysis/ammonia synthesis with opportunity to obtain a doctorate
job_description:
The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft (www.fraunhofer.com) currently operates 76 institutes and research institutions throughout Germany and is the world’s leading applied research organization. Around 30 000 employees work with an annual research budget of 2.9 billion euros.
What you will do
As part of an interdisciplinary research project on the use of ammonia as an energy vector in a future circular and climate-neutral economy, you will carry out research and development work on catalytic ammonia synthesis in a chemical laboratory at our site
in Straubing.
In this research project, several Fraunhofer Institutes are working collaboratively on technical concepts for the use of ammonia for the storage and transportation of renewably produced hydrogen. In this context, your tasks have an application-oriented research focus and include the synthesis of new catalysts and their characterization/testing in the synthesis of ammonia, the implementation of microkinetic studies and their scientific evaluation. The scope and depth of the work is planned as a dissertation project. Accordingly, emphasis is placed on the scientific exploitation of the research results in the form of peer-reviewed articles and conference contributions.
What you bring to the table
Very successfully completed studies of chemistry, chemical engineering or process engineering
Strong interest in scientific tasks in the field of Technical Chemistry, in Power-to-X technologies and catalytic processes and in the application of such processes in a microkinetic laboratory reactor.
Enthusiasm for working with technically complex reactors and for solving technical problems in the daily lab routine
Ability to work independently on scientific tasks and to develop new ideas to approach scientific problems
You are a flexible team player, show commitment and have a confident and friendly manner
You like to take responsibility - for yourself and your actions
This call is addressing candidates who are seriously interested in obtaining a doctorate degree. Willingness and high motivation to write a doctoral thesis are expected.
What you can expect
A diverse, creative and interdisciplinary working environment in a team of the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft at the location Straubing on the Danube
Freedom to develop and implement your own ideas and the opportunity to work conceptually on groundbreaking topics of the future
State-of-the-art working tools and methods, as well as excellent opportunities for professional and personal development
Company pension plan, capital-forming benefits, deferred compensation
Flexible working hours according to a flexitime model and an excellent working atmosphere in a highly motivated team - we would like to develop technologies for a sustainable future together with you!
Onboarding - integration from the very beginning
Worldwide Fraunhofer-network
Mother-child office
The weekly working time is 19,5 hours. This position is limited to 3 years. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability.
Appointment, remuneration and social security benefits based on the public-sector collective wage agreement (TVöD). Additionally Fraunhofer may grant performance-based variable remuneration components.
With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future.
